title: RoboFoundry: System-as-Policy Evolution for Self-Learning Embodied Agents
summary: A foundation model should not act in isolation as an embodied agent. Yet, existing methods often optimize individual components of the agent stack, such as memory, context, skills, or action interfaces, rather than treating the supporting system itself as a unified policy. Moreover, interaction alone does not yield self-improvement unless execution experience is converted into persistent, validated system changes. We therefore propose RoboFoundry, the first embodied agentic framework that formulates this process as Self-Evolving System-as-Policy. RoboFoundry diagnoses capability gaps in decision-making and memory management, converts execution traces into validated task-specific system updates, and promotes recurring improvements to the general system. Evolution operates over two complementary surfaces: a context system that manages active internal context and persistent file-system memory, and a hierarchical skill system that organizes atomic skills, reusable compositions, and failure-conditioned recovery. A shared semantic interface separates embodiment-invariant decisions from embodiment-specific execution, allowing evolved system capabilities to transfer across heterogeneous robots. On EmbodiedBench, RoboFoundry achieves state-of-the-art performance, notably improving GPT-5.5 by 27.8%. It also brings Qwen3.7-Plus to near parity with GPT-5.5 (70.3% vs. 72.7%), showing consistent gains from system-as-policy evolution across foundation models. For long-horizon memory, RoboFoundry outperforms all baselines on RoboMemArena by at least 39.0%, even against methods assisted by external foundation models. On LIBERO-PRO, it further outperforms Cap-Agent0 by 243.8%-679.7% across all perturbation types. In real-world deployments, RoboFoundry demonstrates zero-shot transfer and online evolution across robots and tasks, highlighting its potential for fully autonomous embodied agents.
tldr: RoboFoundry introduces a self-evolving system-as-policy framework for embodied agents, treating the entire agent stack (context, memory, skills) as a unified, evolvable policy, achieving state-of-the-art results on EmbodiedBench and other benchmarks with real-world zero-shot transfer and online evolution.
tldr_zh: RoboFoundry 提出了一种自进化系统即策略的框架，将具身智能体的整个系统（上下文、记忆、技能）视为可进化的统一策略，在 EmbodiedBench 等基准上取得最优结果，并在真实世界展示零样本迁移和在线进化能力。
summary_zh: 基础模型不应作为具身智能体孤立地运作。然而，现有方法往往优化智能体堆栈中的各个组件，如记忆、上下文、技能或动作接口，而非将支撑系统本身视为统一的策略。此外，仅靠交互本身并不能实现自我改进，除非执行经验被转化为持久的、经过验证的系统变更。为此，我们提出RoboFoundry，这是首个将这一过程形式化为“自进化系统即策略”（Self-Evolving System-as-Policy）的具身智能体框架。RoboFoundry诊断决策与记忆管理中的能力缺口，将执行轨迹转化为经验证的任务特定系统更新，并促进对通用系统的持续改进。进化过程在两个互补的层面上运行：一个管理活动内部上下文和持久文件系统记忆的上下文系统，以及一个组织原子技能、可复用组合和故障条件恢复的分层技能系统。共享语义接口将具身无关的决策与具身特定的执行相分离，使进化后的系统能力能够在异构机器人之间迁移。在EmbodiedBench上，RoboFoundry达到了最先进的性能，显著提升了GPT-5.5达27.8%。同时，它将Qwen3.7-Plus提升至与GPT-5.5几乎持平的水平（70.3%对72.7%），展示了系统即策略进化在多种基础模型上的一致性收益。在长时程记忆方面，RoboFoundry在RoboMemArena上以至少39.0%的优势超越所有基线方法，甚至优于借助外部基础模型辅助的方法。在LIBERO-PRO上，它进一步在所有扰动类型中超越Cap-Agent0达243.8%-679.7%。在实际部署中，RoboFoundry展示了跨机器人和任务的零样本迁移与在线进化能力，彰显了其在完全自主具身智能体方面的潜力。

title: InfraVLA: Extending Vision-Language-Action Navigation with Infrastructure Cameras
summary: Many indoor environments in which robots operate, such as warehouses, offices, and hospitals, already have cameras installed. They observe parts of the building that the robot cannot see from where it stands, yet navigation policies, including recent vision-language-action (VLA) models, do not use them. We propose InfraVLA, an end-to-end method that adapts a pretrained navigation VLA to such static infrastructure views: a closed-circuit television (CCTV) encoder turns each external view into tokens of the input sequence. Because the views matter only at rare decision points, fine-tuning alone did not make the policy use them in our experiments; we therefore train in two stages, on demonstrations with upsampled counterfactual data and then on recovery data. We evaluate on two simulated warehouse tasks, finding an object named in the instruction and rerouting around blocked aisles, where the deciding information is often visible only to the infrastructure cameras. Tested in distribution, InfraVLA reached a success rate of 100% on both, against 34.0% and 73.6% for a baseline without CCTV input. On out-of-distribution test sets it reached 88.2% and 88.9%. On a real quadruped fine-tuned with under 10 minutes of demonstrations, the policy reached 83.3% against 29.2% for the on-board-only baseline.
tldr: InfraVLA extends a pretrained vision-language-action navigation policy by integrating infrastructure (CCTV) camera views as input tokens, using two-stage training with counterfactual and recovery data, and demonstrates large success-rate gains in simulated warehouse tasks and on a real quadruped.
tldr_zh: InfraVLA 通过将基础设施（CCTV）摄像头视角作为输入标记集成到预训练的视觉-语言-行动导航策略中，并采用反事实和恢复数据的两阶段训练，在模拟仓库任务和真实四足机器人上大幅提升了成功率。
summary_zh: 许多机器人作业的室内环境，如仓库、办公室和医院，已经安装了摄像头。这些摄像头能够观察到机器人所在位置无法看到的建筑部分，然而，包括最新的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在内的导航策略并未利用这些摄像头。我们提出了InfraVLA，一种端到端方法，将预训练的导航VLA适配到这类静态基础设施视角：一个闭路电视（CCTV）编码器将每个外部视角转换为输入序列的令牌。由于这些视角仅在少数决策点起作用，在我们的实验中，仅靠微调并未使策略利用它们；因此，我们分两个阶段进行训练，首先使用上采样反事实数据的示范，然后使用恢复数据。我们在两个模拟仓库任务上进行了评估：寻找指令中命名的物体以及绕过堵塞通道改道，这些任务中的关键信息往往仅基础设施摄像头可见。在分布内测试中，InfraVLA在两个任务上的成功率均达到100%，而没有CCTV输入的基线分别为34.0%和73.6%。在分布外测试集上，成功率分别达到88.2%和88.9%。在真实四足机器人上，使用不到10分钟的示范数据进行微调后，策略的成功率达到83.3%，而仅依赖机载传感器的基线为29.2%。

title: SLIP-VLA: Single-Step Latent Imagination for Policy Learning in Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-Language-Action models are increasingly effective for robotic manipulation, yet most predict actions directly from current observations without explicitly modeling future scene evolution. Recent methods introduce future prediction to improve action generation, but dense future modeling often requires expensive iterative denoising, while one-step alternatives can underperform their multi-step counterparts. To reconcile efficient future modeling with strong action performance, we present SLIP-VLA, a policy learning framework that equips VLA models with a Single-Step Latent Imagination for future-aware action prediction. SLIP-VLA obtains temporally dense future latent representations with a single denoising update, and we improve the perceptual sufficiency of these representations by aligning intermediate latents with future geometric and semantic features. We further improve their control sufficiency through action-conditioned latent world modeling and inverse dynamics modeling, explicitly coupling latent transitions with robot actions. SLIP-VLA achieves state-of-the-art performance across diverse simulation benchmarks and real-world manipulation tasks, while its single-step latent imagination takes only 12 ms.
tldr: SLIP-VLA introduces a single-step latent imagination module for VLA models, enabling efficient future-aware action prediction by aligning latent representations with geometric/semantic features and coupling latent transitions with actions via world/inverse dynamics modeling, achieving SOTA on simulation and real robot tasks with only 12 ms computation.
tldr_zh: SLIP-VLA 为 VLA 模型引入单步潜在想象模块，通过将潜在表征与几何/语义特征对齐，并结合动作条件世界模型和逆动力学模型，在仅需 12 毫秒计算的情况下实现高效未来感知动作预测，在仿真和真实机器人任务上达到 SOTA 性能。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作模型在机器人操控任务中日益高效，然而大多数模型直接根据当前观测预测动作，并未显式建模未来场景的演化过程。近期方法引入未来预测以提升动作生成质量，但稠密的未来建模往往需要昂贵的迭代去噪过程，而单步替代方案则可能逊色于多步对应方法。为在高效未来建模与强动作性能之间取得平衡，我们提出SLIP-VLA，一种策略学习框架，赋予VLA模型单步潜在想象能力，以实现面向未来的动作预测。SLIP-VLA通过单步去噪更新获取时间上稠密的未来潜在表示，并通过将中间潜在表示与未来几何及语义特征对齐，提升这些表示的感知充分性。我们进一步通过动作条件下的潜在世界建模与逆动力学建模，增强其控制充分性，显式地将潜在状态转换与机器人动作耦合。SLIP-VLA在多种仿真基准及真实世界操控任务中均达到最先进性能，而其单步潜在想象仅需12毫秒。

title: FocusDrive: Reasoning with Visual Focus for Autonomous Driving
summary: Driving decisions depend on both where to focus and how to act on what is seen. Effective driving reasoning must establish which objects matter, where they are, and how they inform the intended action. Text-based rationales can describe a driving response while leaving its correspondence to specific visual evidence implicit. Visual focus provides a concrete starting point for this connection by identifying what matters in the scene and where it is. We propose FocusDrive, a structured multimodal reasoning framework that organizes end-to-end planning around explicit visual focus. It pairs descriptions of decision-relevant objects with image-patch references, bringing explicit visual focus into the reasoning that generates driving plans and trajectories. We first assess this focus representation through driver gaze prediction, then investigate its role in planning reasoning using driving-focus annotations within existing NAVSIM training scenes. Experiments on W3DA and NAVSIM demonstrate competitive gaze prediction and end-to-end planning performance, with FocusDrive improving over text-based chain-of-thought. These results support visual focus as an effective link between scene understanding and driving action.
tldr: FocusDrive introduces a structured multimodal reasoning framework for autonomous driving that integrates explicit visual focus (image-patch references of decision-relevant objects) into end-to-end planning and trajectory generation, showing improved performance over text-based chain-of-thought on NAVSIM and W3DA benchmarks.
tldr_zh: FocusDrive 提出了一种用于自动驾驶的结构化多模态推理框架，将显式的视觉焦点（决策相关对象的图像块引用）整合到端到端规划和轨迹生成中，在 NAVSIM 和 W3DA 基准上显示出优于基于文本的思维链的性能。
summary_zh: 驾驶决策既取决于关注何处，也取决于如何对所见的景象采取行动。有效的驾驶推理必须确定哪些物体是重要的、它们位于何处，以及它们如何为预期的操作提供信息。基于文本的推理可以描述驾驶响应，但将其与特定视觉证据的对应关系留作隐含信息。视觉焦点通过识别场景中重要的物体及其位置，为这一联系提供了具体的起点。我们提出了FocusDrive，一种结构化的多模态推理框架，围绕显式视觉焦点组织端到端规划。它将决策相关物体的描述与图像块引用相结合，将显式视觉焦点引入生成驾驶计划和轨迹的推理过程中。我们首先通过驾驶员注视预测评估这一焦点表示，然后利用现有NAVSIM训练场景中的驾驶焦点标注研究其在规划推理中的作用。在W3DA和NAVSIM上的实验表明，FocusDrive在注视预测和端到端规划性能上均具有竞争力，且相比基于文本的思维链方法有所提升。这些结果支持视觉焦点作为场景理解与驾驶行为之间的有效桥梁。

title: Train Together or Merge Later? Unifying VLA Experts via a Shared Action Interface
summary: Co-training offers a straightforward way to build a multi-task vision-language-action (VLA) policy, but can fall short of the performance achieved by training each task independently. The challenge is to retain these task-specific gains in a multi-task policy without joint post-training. Combining independently trained experts through model merging is a natural approach, yet strong individual experts do not necessarily yield a strong merged policy. We identify one source of this incompatibility: task-specific changes to the action interface, comprising action normalization and the action encoder and decoder. We propose PolicyWeave, combining merge-compatible post-training with context-guided sparse merging. During post-training, all experts retain the common base policy's action interface, while task adaptation is restricted to LoRA updates in the hidden layers of the action model. This makes the experts more compatible with existing model merging methods. However, merging all experts can still introduce interference from unrelated tasks at deployment. PolicyWeave scores each expert's LoRA updates using the initial visual-language context, determines the expert set through leave-one-layer-out ranking stability, and forms a sparse weighted merge of the selected updates that remains fixed for current task. We evaluate PolicyWeave with GR00T N1.5 on 18 RoboCasa365 tasks, using only 10% of the target-task demonstrations for supervised fine-tuning (SFT). Preserving the shared action interface raises the average success rate across four static merging methods from 17.0% to 52.8%. PolicyWeave achieves 64.7% success with these SFT experts and 74.1% after task-specific reinforcement learning (RL), compared with 60.7% for joint RL. Further evaluations on LIBERO-10 and an AgileX Piper arm support the deployment of independently learned skills in long-horizon and real-world manipulation.
tldr: This paper introduces PolicyWeave, a method for merging independently trained VLA policy experts by preserving a common action interface during post-training and using context-guided sparse merging of LoRA updates, demonstrating improved multi-task performance over joint training on RoboCasa365 and real-world tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了PolicyWeave，通过在微调时保留共享动作接口并使用基于上下文的稀疏合并LoRA更新，实现独立训练的VLA策略专家的有效合并，在RoboCasa365和真实机器人任务上优于联合训练。
summary_zh: 摘要：协同训练为构建多任务视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略提供了一种直接的方法，但其性能可能不及独立训练每个任务所达到的效果。挑战在于如何在多任务策略中保留这些任务特定的增益，而无需进行联合后训练。通过模型合并来组合独立训练的专家是一种自然的方案，但强个体专家并不必然产生强合并策略。我们识别出这种不兼容性的一个来源：动作接口的任务特定改动，包括动作归一化以及动作编码器和解码器。我们提出PolicyWeave，将兼容合并的后训练与上下文引导的稀疏合并相结合。在后训练过程中，所有专家保留基础策略共用的动作接口，而任务适应被限制为动作模型隐藏层中的LoRA更新。这使得专家与现有模型合并方法更加兼容。然而，合并所有专家仍可能在部署时引入来自无关任务的干扰。PolicyWeave利用初始视觉-语言上下文对各专家的LoRA更新进行评分，通过留一层在外的排序稳定性确定专家集合，并对选中的更新形成稀疏加权合并，且该合并结果在当前任务中保持固定。我们在GR00T N1.5上对18个RoboCasa365任务进行了评估，仅使用目标任务演示的10%进行监督微调（SFT）。保留共享动作接口使四种静态合并方法的平均成功率从17.0%提升至52.8%。PolicyWeave在使用这些SFT专家时达到了64.7%的成功率，在任务特定强化学习（RL）后达到74.1%，而联合RL的成功率为60.7%。在LIBERO-10和AgileX Piper机械臂上的进一步评估支持了在长时程和真实世界操作中部署独立学习的技能。

title: CodeActionBench: Evaluating Agentic Code-as-Policy for Embodied Manipulation
summary: How well can general-purpose multimodal models turn visual understanding and reasoning into embodied manipulation via executable code? We introduce CodeActionBench, a benchmark of 25 manipulation tasks that evaluates this capability through agentic Code-as-Policy. Without task-specific fine-tuning, demonstrations, external specialist perception or grasp modules, privileged scene state, or predefined task policies, agents should select visual evidence, form task-relevant 3D estimates, construct manipulation targets, and iteratively execute and revise their policies. A shared robot API provides RGB observations, calibrated geometric operations, robot feedback, and bounded motion, leaving task-dependent decisions to the evaluated agent. Fixed task instances, resource budgets, and a hidden physical-outcome verifier support controlled comparisons across models and harness configurations. Extensive evaluations across nine configurations and 675 attempts achieve success rates ranging from 2.7% to 73.3%. The strongest configuration, GPT-6 Astra with Codex CLI, solves 22 of 25 tasks at least once in three attempts, demonstrating the best performance while still leaving substantial room for improvement. Trajectory analyses reveal difficulties in spatial alignment, object retention, and completion judgment, including task failures despite successfully completed motions. CodeActionBench provides a controlled testbed for measuring how general-purpose models translate their capabilities into manipulation behavior and for examining typical failure scenarios in that process.
tldr: Introduces CodeActionBench, a benchmark with 25 manipulation tasks evaluating agentic Code-as-Policy with multimodal models, showing GPT-6 Astra + Codex CLI solves 22/25 tasks at least once, with successes ranging 2.7% to 73.3% across configurations.
tldr_zh: 提出了CodeActionBench，一个包含25个操作任务的基准，用于评估基于代码的智能体策略，结果显示GPT-6 Astra结合Codex CLI在25个任务中至少成功解决22个，不同配置的成功率介于2.7%到73.3%之间。
summary_zh: 通用多模态模型在多大程度上能够通过可执行代码将视觉理解与推理转化为具身操作？我们提出了CodeActionBench，一个包含25个操作任务的基准，通过代理式代码即策略（Code-as-Policy）来评估这一能力。在无需任务特定微调、示范数据、外部专业感知或抓取模块、特权场景状态或预定义任务策略的条件下，智能体应自主选择视觉证据、形成任务相关的三维估计、构建操作目标，并迭代执行和修正其策略。共享的机器人API提供RGB观测、标定几何操作、机器人反馈及受限运动，而任务相关的决策则交由被评估的智能体完成。固定的任务实例、资源预算和隐藏的物理结果验证器支持跨模型和配置组合的受控比较。我们在九种配置和675次尝试中进行了广泛评估，成功率从2.7%到73.3%不等。最强的配置——GPT-6 Astra配合Codex CLI——在三次尝试中至少成功解决了25项任务中的22项，展现出最佳性能，但仍留有显著提升空间。轨迹分析揭示了空间对齐、物体保持和完成判断方面的困难，包括在动作成功执行后任务仍然失败的情况。CodeActionBench为衡量通用模型如何将其能力转化为操作行为，以及检验该过程中典型失败场景，提供了一个受控测试平台。

title: Principal Steering Subspaces for Online Adaptation of Frozen Generative Robot Policies
summary: Generative robot policies provide expressive behavior priors, but updating a large diffusion or flow-matching model through online interaction is costly. Latent-space reinforcement learning avoids updating the pretrained generator by controlling its initial sampling noise, yet high-dimensional noise can have strongly anisotropic effects on decoded actions. We introduce Principal Steering Subspaces (PSS), a forward-query interface that constructs a fixed low-dimensional control basis from finite-difference decoder responses. Soft Actor-Critic controls the leading response directions, while the orthogonal complement is independently resampled from the Gaussian prior at each query. On three RoboMimic tasks with diffusion and flow-matching policies, response spectra reveal substantial concentration. Across five matched task-generator pairs, the training curves indicate that PSS generally converges faster and exhibits more stable late-training behavior than full-latent control, while achieving stronger final performance overall. Controlled Diffusion-Square ablations further show that leading-response directions outperform random and least-responsive subspaces of equal dimension. We further integrate PSS with a frozen, closed-source 3B-parameter vision-language-action (VLA) policy in a humanoid learning system with synchronous transition collection, reset-time optimization, and latency-aware asynchronous deployment. In an exploratory screwdriver-placement evaluation, success is observed in 2/10 trials for the frozen VLA policy and 6/10 after SAC+PSS adaptation. These results support decoder-response geometry as a practical basis for online adaptation of frozen generative robot policies.
tldr: This paper introduces Principal Steering Subspaces (PSS), a method for online adaptation of frozen generative robot policies by identifying a low-dimensional control basis from decoder response geometry, demonstrating improved performance on RoboMimic tasks and a humanoid VLA policy.
tldr_zh: 论文提出主转向子空间（PSS）方法，通过解码器响应几何构造低维控制基，实现冻结生成式机器人策略的在线适应，在RoboMimic和人形VLA策略上提升效果。
summary_zh: 生成式机器人策略提供了表达性的行为先验，但通过在线交互更新大规模扩散或流匹配模型成本高昂。潜在空间强化学习通过控制初始采样噪声来避免更新预训练生成器，然而高维噪声对解码动作可能产生强烈的各向异性影响。我们提出了主转向子空间（PSS），一种前向查询接口，通过有限差分解码器响应构建固定的低维控制基。软演员-评论家算法控制主要响应方向，而正交补空间则在每次查询时独立地从高斯先验中重新采样。在三个使用扩散和流匹配策略的RoboMimic任务中，响应谱显示出显著的集中性。在五组匹配的任务-生成器组合中，训练曲线表明PSS总体上比全潜空间控制收敛更快，并在训练后期表现出更稳定的行为，同时整体上实现了更强的最终性能。受控的Diffusion-Square消融实验进一步表明，主要响应方向优于等维度的随机子空间和最小响应子空间。我们还将PSS与冻结的、闭源的30亿参数视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略集成到一个具身学习系统中，该系统具有同步转移收集、重置时间优化和延迟感知异步部署功能。在一项探索性的螺丝刀放置评估中，冻结的VLA策略在10次试验中有2次成功，而经过SAC+PSS自适应后达到了10次中的6次成功。这些结果支持将解码器响应几何作为冻结生成式机器人策略在线自适应的实用基础。

title: AnyStep-WAM: Budget-Aligned Distillation and Adaptive Inference for World Action Models
summary: World-action models (WAMs) couple predictive visual modeling with action generation, typically relying on iterative denoising with a fixed denoising steps. However, manipulation tasks contain actions chunks with varying sensitivity to generation errors: critical actions require precision, while less sensitive actions allow faster generation with fewer denoising steps. Here we introduce AnyStep World Action Model, a general framework for tunable-budget prediction and scene-dependent computation allocation. Our budget-aligned teacher-trajectory distillation trains interval-conditioned flow maps using explicit frozen-teacher transitions and shared low-rank adapters, supporting action generation from one-step prediction to multi-step refinement. Building on this capability, a lightweight risk-benefit scheduler predicts teacher-curvature-based difficulty and budget-specific student-teacher fidelity from a single one-step preview, selecting the smallest budget predicted to satisfy risk-adaptive fidelity requirements. We evaluate our framework on three widely used WAMs Motus, FastWAM, and LingBotVA using RoboTwin 2.0. Our method reduces average denoising steps by 60.2%, 49.8%, and 85.28%, respectively, while maintaining baseline task success rates. In particular, our AnyStep training substantially improves model performance under a one-step denoising budget, increasing task success rates by 7.07%, 12.08%, and 8.94% on Motus, FastWAM, and LingBotVA, respectively. Experiments on six real-world manipulation tasks further validate its effectiveness.
tldr: This paper introduces AnyStep-WAM, a framework for world action models that adaptively adjusts denoising steps based on action sensitivity, significantly reducing computation while maintaining task success rates in manipulation tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了AnyStep-WAM框架，该框架根据动作敏感性自适应调整去噪步骤，在保持操作任务成功率的同时显著降低计算量。
summary_zh: 世界-动作模型（WAMs）将预测性视觉建模与动作生成相结合，通常依赖于固定去噪步数的迭代去噪过程。然而，操作任务中包含对生成误差敏感度各异的动作块：关键动作需要高精度，而敏感度较低的动作则允许通过更少的去噪步数实现更快生成。为此，我们提出任意步世界-动作模型（AnyStep World Action Model），一个用于可调预算预测和场景相关计算分配的通用框架。我们的预算对齐教师轨迹蒸馏方法利用显式冻结教师转换和共享低秩适配器训练区间条件流映射，支持从单步预测到多步细化的动作生成。基于此能力，一个轻量级风险-收益调度器从单步预览中预测基于教师曲率的难度以及特定预算下的师生保真度，选择满足风险自适应保真度要求的最小预测预算。我们在三种广泛使用的WAM模型——Motus、FastWAM和LingBotVA——上使用RoboTwin 2.0进行评估。我们的方法分别将平均去噪步数减少60.2%、49.8%和85.28%，同时保持基线任务成功率不变。特别地，我们的任意步训练在单步去噪预算下显著提升了模型性能，在Motus、FastWAM和LingBotVA上的任务成功率分别提高7.07%、12.08%和8.94%。在六个真实世界操作任务上的实验进一步验证了其有效性。

title: MomWorld: Momentum-Aware Latent World Model for Long-Horizon Autonomous Driving
summary: Long-horizon planning enables autonomous vehicles to anticipate scene evolution and potential risks, supporting safe and stable decisions in complex interactions. However, existing methods struggle to propagate motion trends from observed history into the future. Long rollouts based on a single latent state may further attenuate useful dynamics, retain stale motion patterns, and disrupt reliable near-term plans. We introduce MomWorld, a momentum-aware latent world model for long-horizon planning. MomWorld extracts scene motion trends from historical-to-current observations and propagates latent momentum into future horizons, jointly predicting future configuration and momentum states. A learnable momentum persistence mechanism preserves stable trends, scene-conditioned momentum updates adapt future dynamics, and a scene-adaptive reset gate suppresses stale momentum under abrupt changes. We further propose MoFlow, a momentum-conditioned flow-matching module that refines a base trajectory to align with the predicted future scene evolution in only a few integration steps, with a horizon-aware residual fusion that preserves near-term planning stability while permitting stronger long-range corrections. Extensive experiments on NAVSIM, nuScenes and Bench2Drive demonstrate that MomWorld improves long-horizon planning consistency and reduces the average collision rate by 12.2% relative to MomAD over a 6-second planning horizon.
tldr: MomWorld introduces a momentum-aware latent world model for long-horizon autonomous driving, jointly predicting future configuration and momentum states, and uses a momentum-conditioned flow-matching module (MoFlow) to refine trajectories, reducing collision rates by 12.2% over 6-second horizons.
tldr_zh: MomWorld 提出了一种动量感知的潜在世界模型，用于长时域自动驾驶，联合预测未来配置和动量状态，并通过动量条件流匹配模块（MoFlow）细化轨迹，在6秒规划范围内将碰撞率降低12.2%。
summary_zh: 长时域规划使自动驾驶车辆能够预判场景演变和潜在风险，从而在复杂交互中支持安全稳定的决策。然而，现有方法难以将观测历史中的运动趋势传播至未来。基于单一潜在状态的长距离推演可能进一步衰减有效动态信息，保留过时的运动模式，并干扰可靠的近期规划。我们提出MomWorld，一种面向长时域规划的动量感知潜在世界模型。MomWorld从历史至当前观测中提取场景运动趋势，并将潜在动量传播至未来时域，联合预测未来的构型状态和动量状态。可学习的动量持久化机制保持稳定趋势，场景条件化的动量更新适应未来动态变化，而场景自适应重置门则在剧变情况下抑制过时动量。我们进一步提出MoFlow，一种动量条件化的流匹配模块，仅需少量积分步骤即可将基础轨迹精炼至与预测的未来场景演变对齐，并通过时域感知残差融合在保持近期规划稳定性的同时允许更强的远期修正。在NAVSIM、nuScenes和Bench2Drive上的大量实验表明，MomWorld提升了长时域规划的一致性，并在6秒规划时域内相较于MomAD将平均碰撞率降低了12.2%。

title: Does Adversarial Training Improve Generalization in Multi-View VLAs? Revealing and Mitigating View Collapse
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models adapt pretrained vision-language models (VLMs) for closed-loop robot control, transferring their perceptual and semantic capabilities to action prediction. Despite strong in-distribution performance, however, VLAs often degrade under deployment shifts. Adversarial training (AT) offers a model-adaptive approach to robustness without explicitly anticipating individual shifts, but its effect on natural distribution-shift generalization in multi-view VLAs remains unclear. We study this question using a multi-view VLA directly adapted from a pretrained VLM and evaluate generalization across seven LIBERO-Plus shift axes. Direct AT substantially improves Camera Viewpoint and Sensor Noise, the two shifts affecting only the third-person view, yet produces mixed or negative effects on other shifts. Controlled view interventions reveal a surprising failure mode that we term view collapse: Direct AT can shift cross-view reliance so strongly that the policy becomes dominated by the wrist view. This exposes a \textit{robustness shortcut}: apparent robustness to a shifted view can arise from reduced use of that view rather than more robust perception of it. This motivates a distinction between robust perception, extracting reliable information under within-view shifts, and robust fusion, adapting reliance across views according to their reliability. To reduce fixed view reliance, we use a simple View Swap intervention and then re-evaluate AT. With View Swap, AT further improves Camera Viewpoint, Sensor Noise, and Robot Initial State, while its effects remain mixed on other shifts. Our results show that multi-view robustness requires separating improved perception from changes in cross-view reliance, and that AT provides selective rather than generic distribution-shift benefits.
tldr: This paper investigates adversarial training (AT) for multi-view Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, revealing a 'view collapse' failure mode where AT can shift cross-view reliance to a single view, and proposes a View Swap intervention to mitigate this, showing selective robustness improvements on shifts like Camera Viewpoint and Sensor Noise in LIBERO-Plus.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了多视角视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的对抗训练（AT），揭示了AT可能导致模型过度依赖单一视角的“视角坍缩”失败模式，并提出视角交换干预来缓解，在LIBERO-Plus基准上展示了对抗训练对特定分布偏移（如相机视点和传感器噪声）的选择性鲁棒性提升。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型将预训练的视觉-语言模型（VLM）适配于闭环机器人控制，将其感知与语义能力迁移至动作预测。尽管在分布内表现强劲，但VLA在部署环境发生偏移时往往会性能退化。对抗训练（AT）提供了一种模型自适应式的鲁棒性方法，无需显式预判各类偏移，但其对多视角VLA在自然分布偏移泛化中的影响仍不明确。本研究采用一个直接从预训练VLM适配而来的多视角VLA，并评估其在LIBERO-Plus七个偏移轴上的泛化表现。直接进行对抗训练显著提升了摄像机视角与传感器噪声两类仅影响第三视角的偏移，但对其他偏移则产生混合或负面效果。通过受控的视角干预实验，我们揭示了一种令人意外的失效模式，称之为视角崩塌（view collapse）：直接对抗训练会剧烈改变跨视角依赖，使得策略被手腕视角主导。这暴露了一种“鲁棒性捷径”：对偏移视角的表面鲁棒性可能源于对该视角使用程度的降低，而非对该视角感知能力的增强。因此，我们区分两种概念：鲁棒感知，即在视角内偏移中提取可靠信息的能力；以及鲁棒融合，即根据各视角可靠性动态调整跨视角依赖的能力。为降低固定的视角依赖，我们采用简单的视角互换（View Swap）干预并重新评估对抗训练。在视角互换条件下，对抗训练进一步改善了摄像机视角、传感器噪声及机器人初始状态三类偏移，但对其他偏移的影响仍为混合。我们的结果表明，多视角鲁棒性需要将感知能力的提升与跨视角依赖的变化加以区分，且对抗训练提供的是选择性而非通用性的分布偏移收益。

title: Demonstration-Free Success-Probability Reward Learning for Generalist Robot Policies
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) enables generalist robot policies to improve through trial-and-error interaction, yet its effectiveness is fundamentally constrained by sparse task rewards. Existing general-purpose reward models typically alleviate this issue by learning task progress from expert demonstrations, but introduce a distribution mismatch with the mixed-quality rollouts encountered during policy optimization, making their estimates unreliable on suboptimal and failed behaviors from which the policy must learn. In this work, we introduce a demonstration-free reward learning paradigm where dense reward feedback can be learned directly from sparse task outcomes and policy experience. We theoretically show that terminal task outcomes implicitly define dense success-probability feedback at intermediate timesteps, which can be recursively learned through bootstrapping. Based on this insight, we introduce eVTA$_0$, which learns success probabilities from mixed-quality policy rollouts through temporal-difference-style bootstrapping, without expert demonstrations or intermediate annotations. We further introduce RL with Evolving Rewards (RLER), a closed-loop framework that adapts eVTA$_0$ using newly collected rollouts as the policy evolves. Experiments show that eVTA$_0$ provides more informative rewards than state-of-the-art reward models and achieves the best average policy performance across all LIBERO task suites under the same RL training budget, improving success rates by 5.4%-13.8% over the initial policy. In real-world manipulation, RLER further improves overall success rates by 20%-26%, with 35%-36% gains under out-of-distribution conditions. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of demonstration-free reward learning and adapting rewards as the policy evolves. Project webpage: https://duowuyms.github.io/evta0.
tldr: This paper introduces eVTA0, a demonstration-free reward learning method that learns success probabilities from mixed-quality rollouts via temporal-difference bootstrapping, and RLER, a closed-loop framework to adapt rewards as the policy evolves, improving manipulation policy performance in LIBERO and real-world tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出无演示奖励学习方法 eVTA0，通过时序差分自举从混合质量轨迹中学习成功概率，并引入 RLER 闭环框架随策略进化调整奖励，在 LIBERO 和真实机器人操作任务中提升了策略性能。
summary_zh: 强化学习（RL）使通用机器人策略能够通过试错交互进行改进，但其有效性从根本上受到稀疏任务奖励的制约。现有的通用奖励模型通常通过从专家示范中学习任务进展来缓解这一问题，但会引入与策略优化过程中遇到的混合质量轨迹之间的分布不匹配，从而使其对次优和失败行为的估计不可靠——而策略恰恰需要从这些行为中学习。在本工作中，我们提出了一种无需示范的奖励学习范式，其中密集奖励反馈可以直接从稀疏任务结果和策略经验中学习。我们从理论上证明，终端任务结果在中间时间步隐式定义了密集的成功概率反馈，可以通过自举方式递归学习。基于这一洞见，我们引入了eVTA$_0$，它通过时序差分式自举从混合质量的策略轨迹中学习成功概率，无需专家示范或中间标注。我们进一步引入了具有演化奖励的强化学习（RLER），这是一个闭环框架，随着策略演化，利用新收集的轨迹自适应调整eVTA$_0$。实验表明，在相同的RL训练预算下，eVTA$_0$比最先进的奖励模型提供更具信息量的奖励，并在所有LIBERO任务套件中取得了最佳的平均策略性能，相较于初始策略成功率提高了5.4%-13.8%。在真实世界操作中，RLER进一步将整体成功率提高了20%-26%，在分布外条件下实现了35%-36%的提升。这些结果证明了无需示范的奖励学习以及随着策略演化自适应调整奖励的有效性。项目网页：https://duowuyms.github.io/evta0。

title: Beyond One-Step Accuracy: State-Affine Latent Transition for Reliable Visual Planning
summary: Joint-embedding world models enable visual planning by learning action-conditioned dynamics in latent space. Yet they are commonly trained for one-step prediction on encoded states, while planning recursively applies the learned transition to its own predictions. One-step accuracy therefore does not capture how prediction errors propagate under recursive rollout. We decompose multi-step rollout error into the errors introduced at individual steps and their propagation through subsequent transitions. We show that state-affine dynamics are precisely the differentiable transitions with state-independent Jacobians, eliminating the nonlinear propagation residual and making the error propagation operators depend only on the action sequence. Guided by this result, we introduce SALT (State-Affine Latent Transition), an action-conditioned state-affine dynamics model in which the action modulates both the state transformation and the additive update. We train SALT through recursive multi-step rollout supervision, feeding each predicted latent state back into the transition so that training matches how the model is used during planning. Across four visual planning environments, SALT exhibits $1.48$--$2.19\times$ higher one-step prediction error than the matched LeWM baseline, yet improves closed-loop success in every environment by $10.0$ percentage points on average. On OGBench-Cube, the fraction of episodes that fail with a sharp rise in model-predicted cost after execution decreases from $23.3%$ to $2.0%$.
tldr: This paper introduces SALT, a state-affine latent transition model for visual planning that trains with recursive multi-step supervision, achieving higher one-step error but significantly better closed-loop success across four environments.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了SALT，一种用于视觉规划的状态仿射潜变量转移模型，通过递归多步监督训练，在四个环境中实现了更高的单步误差但显著更好的闭环成功率。
summary_zh: 联合嵌入世界模型通过在潜在空间中学习以动作调节的动态过程来实现视觉规划。然而，这类模型通常针对编码状态的一步预测进行训练，而规划过程中会递归地将学习到的转移应用于其自身的预测结果。因此，一步预测的准确性无法反映预测误差在递归展开过程中如何传播。我们将多步展开误差分解为各步骤单独引入的误差及其在后续转移中的传播效应。我们证明了状态仿射动态恰好是那些具有与状态无关的雅可比矩阵的可微转移，从而消除了非线性传播残差，使得误差传播算子仅依赖于动作序列。基于这一发现，我们提出了SALT（状态仿射潜在转移）模型，这是一种以动作调节的状态仿射动态模型，其中动作同时调节状态变换和加法更新。我们通过递归多步展开监督来训练SALT，将每个预测的潜在状态反馈到转移中，从而使训练过程与模型在规划中的实际使用方式保持一致。在四个视觉规划环境中，SALT的一步预测误差比匹配的LeWM基线高出$1.48$--$2.19$倍，但在每个环境中的闭环成功率平均提升了$10.0$个百分点。在OGBench-Cube上，执行后模型预测成本急剧上升的失败回合比例从$23.3\%$降至$2.0\%$。

title: FoLD: Force-Informed Learning for Dexterous Articulated Object Manipulation
summary: Transferring human demonstrations to dexterous robots remains challenging because differences in hand morphology and contact dynamics often cause retargeted motions to fail at producing the intended object behavior. We present \textbf{FoLD}, a framework for learning dexterous manipulation of articulated objects through explicit force guidance. FoLD compute compensatory force fields from human demonstrations together with the robot's current interaction state, yielding a force prior that promotes the demonstrated object motion. This force prior informs a residual policy that adapts retargeted hand motions to the contact requirements of the task. We evaluate FoLD on a public benchmark for articulated object manipulation, where it consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines across tasks and embodiments. We further validate FoLD on real dexterous robot platforms, demonstrating successful transfer of human manipulation skills to robot execution. Here is the link of our project page: https://gghgghgghgg.github.io/FoLD-project-page/.
tldr: FoLD learns dexterous manipulation of articulated objects by computing compensatory force fields from human demonstrations to guide a residual policy, improving real-robot skill transfer.
tldr_zh: FoLD通过从人类演示中计算补偿力场来指导残差策略，从而学习灵巧操作铰接物体，提升了真实机器人技能迁移的效果。
summary_zh: 将人类示教迁移至灵巧机器人仍具挑战性，原因在于手部形态与接触动力学的差异常导致重定向动作无法产生预期的物体行为。我们提出\textbf{FoLD}框架，通过显式力引导学习铰接物体的灵巧操作。FoLD从人类示教中结合机器人当前的交互状态计算补偿力场，形成促进示教物体运动的力先验。该力先验指导残差策略，使重定向的手部动作适应任务的接触要求。我们在公开的铰接物体操作基准上评估FoLD，其在各类任务与实体上均稳定优于最先进基线方法。我们进一步在真实灵巧机器人平台上验证FoLD，展示了人类操作技能向机器人执行的成功迁移。项目页面链接：https://gghgghgghgg.github.io/FoLD-project-page/。

title: Steer2Grasp: Inference-Time Embodiment-Aware Steering for Diverse Physically Feasible Grasp Diffusion
summary: Current grasp diffusion models provide rich priors for generation, yet their object-centric approach can violate the kinematic and collision constraints imposed by the embodiment and the environment. Existing embodiment-aware methods primarily perform local corrections around generated grasps through gradient guidance or optimization, making it difficult to recover from fundamentally infeasible modes. We present Steer2Grasp, a training-free, embodiment-agnostic framework for inference-time grasp steering that adapts a frozen Cartesian grasp diffusion model using deployment-specific rewards. Through Feynman-Kac (FK) inspired particle reweighting and resampling, the method reallocates population mass from infeasible to high-reward grasp modes, enabling population-level mode transitions without modifying the pretrained diffusion model or requiring differentiable constraints. The framework enables a unified treatment for single and dual arm grasping through reachability and collision aware rewards, followed by gradient free gripper level local refinement. Across diverse objects, robot embodiments, and constrained environments, our method substantially improves feasible grasp generation while maintaining proximity to the underlying grasp prior.
tldr: Steer2Grasp is a training-free, embodiment-agnostic inference-time steering framework that uses Feynman-Kac inspired particle reweighting to adapt a frozen grasp diffusion model to deployment-specific reachability and collision constraints, improving feasible grasp generation across diverse embodiments and environments.
tldr_zh: Steer2Grasp是一种免训练、与具体形态无关的推理时引导框架，通过受Feynman-Kac启发的粒子重加权与重采样，将冻结的抓取扩散模型适配到部署中的可达性与碰撞约束，从而在各种机器人形态和受限环境中提升可行抓取生成的成功率。
summary_zh: 现有的抓取扩散模型为生成提供了丰富的先验信息，但其以对象为中心的方法可能违反由具体机器人和环境所施加的运动学及碰撞约束。已有考虑机器人本体的方法主要通过梯度引导或优化对生成的抓取进行局部修正，难以从根本上恢复不可行的模态。我们提出了Steer2Grasp，一种无需训练、与机器人本体无关的推理时抓取引导框架，利用部署特定的奖励函数来引导冻结的笛卡尔抓取扩散模型。通过基于Feynman-Kac（FK）的粒子重新加权与重采样，该方法将种群质量从不可行模态重新分配至高奖励抓取模态，从而在不修改预训练扩散模型或无需可微约束的情况下，实现种群级别的模态转换。该框架通过可达性与碰撞感知奖励实现对单臂和双臂抓取的统一处理，随后进行无梯度的夹爪级局部精细化。在多种物体、机器人本体和受限环境下，我们的方法在保持与基础抓取先验接近的同时，显著提升了可行抓取生成的能力。

title: AMBIT: Anticipatory Multimodal Body Recruitment for Bimanual Tracking on a Humanoid
summary: A humanoid with 5-DoF arms cannot track generic bimanual end-effector trajectories with its arms alone; pelvis and waist motion must be recruited, but which motion, and when, is not uniquely determined. On a Unitree R1 in fixed double support, the set of dynamically valid recruitment strategies (pelvis pose and waist trajectories) for a task is a diverse continuous manifold, and a deterministic regressor trained on it mode-averages into strategies valid only 35% of the time, against 52% for a conditional variational autoencoder (CVAE) and 82% for the best of 16 CVAE samples. We introduce AMBIT: the CVAE proposes strategies from a preview of the commanded trajectory, a non-learned selector filters, ranks and verifies them, and a receding-horizon loop commits to one with hysteresis. The committed strategy is the reference of the same whole-body differential-IK QP a reactive tracker runs, which keeps authority over residual error. On 160 held-out episodes that admit a valid strategy, in full MuJoCo dynamics under a torque controller, AMBIT reaches 85% success at a 3 cm/15 deg tolerance against 74% for the tracker (disjoint confidence intervals) and recruits the body before the arms saturate in 48% of episodes against 35%. Because diversity is preserved, constraints unknown at training time are enforced by selection alone: under five zero-shot shifts AMBIT beats the warm-started tracker on every shift and matches a test-time re-optimisation baseline 17x more expensive. On a Unitree G1, with hyperparameters unchanged, the protocol reproduces the structure of the valid set and widens the gap over the tracker to 0.85 against 0.53. Five selected strategies execute on the externally supported physical R1, distinct in pelvis excursion and tracking the planned end-effector motion to a median of 11 mm by encoder forward kinematics, which establishes kinematic realisability, not balance.
tldr: AMBIT uses a CVAE to propose diverse whole-body recruitment strategies (pelvis and waist motion) for bimanual tracking on a humanoid, with a non-learned selector and receding-horizon loop that improves success over reactive tracking and generalizes to zero-shot shifts and a second robot.
tldr_zh: AMBIT 使用 CVAE 为双手机器人跟踪提出多样化的全身参与策略（骨盆和腰部运动），通过非学习选择器和滚动时域循环，在成功率、零样本迁移和新机器人上均优于反应式跟踪。
summary_zh:
摘要：  
具有5自由度手臂的人形机器人仅凭手臂无法跟踪通用的双臂末端执行器轨迹；必须调动骨盆和腰部运动，但具体调动何种运动以及何时调动并不唯一确定。在Unitree R1固定双足支撑条件下，任务对应的动态有效调动策略（骨盆姿态与腰部轨迹）构成一个多样的连续流形。在该流形上训练的确定性回归器会因模式平均而产生仅在35%时间内有效的策略，而条件变分自编码器（CVAE）为52%，16个CVAE样本中最佳者为82%。我们提出AMBIT方法：CVAE根据指令轨迹的预览提出策略，非学习型选择器对策略进行过滤、排序和验证，并采用带滞回的重构视界循环对策略进行提交。所提交的策略即为同一全身微分IK二次规划问题的参考，该规划由反应式跟踪器运行，保留对残余误差的控制权。在160个保留测试场景中（均存在有效策略），在转矩控制器下的完整MuJoCo动力学环境中，AMBIT在3 cm/15度容差下达到85%的成功率，而跟踪器为74%（置信区间不重叠）；在48%的场景中，AMBIT在手臂饱和前即调动身体参与，而跟踪器仅为35%。由于多样性得以保留，训练时未知的约束仅通过选择即可强制执行：在五次零样本迁移下，AMBIT在每次迁移中均优于热启动跟踪器，并与耗时17倍以上的测试时再优化基线持平。在Unitree G1上，在超参数不变的情况下，该协议复现了有效集合的结构，并将与跟踪器的差距扩大至0.85对0.53。此外，五种选定策略在外部支撑的物理R1平台上执行，在骨盆偏移上各有不同，并通过编码器正运动学实现对规划末端执行器运动的跟踪中位误差为11 mm，这验证了运动学可实现性，而非平衡性能。

title: VIDEAS: Distilling Explicit Action Semantics from Demonstration Videos for World Models via Prior-Guided Simulation
summary: World models learn internal representations of environment dynamics to predict future states, enabling agents to optimize action plans without physical interactions. However, developing world models that genuinely internalize underlying causal physical laws to explicitly reason about action preconditions and subsequent state transitions remains an open challenge. In this paper, we propose VIDEAS, a data distillation framework that transforms continuous physical dynamics from operational videos into explicit action semantics for foundation models. Specifically, it deconstructs visual demonstrations into discrete action trajectories and utilizes advanced vision-language models (VLMs) to extract structured knowledge encapsulating action preconditions and effects. To ensure physical consistency, we introduce a prior-guided trajectory simulation mechanism grounded within a text-based environment to rigorously validate the extracted knowledge. Notably, we incorporate negative trajectories to enrich knowledge completeness and enhance data diversity to mitigate cognitive bias. Furthermore, we present VIDEAS-WM, an 8B/9B-parameter suite of language-based world models trained on 34K high-quality samples derived from AgiBot-World dataset. Extensive experiments demonstrate that VIDEAS-WM establishes state-of-the-art performance in high-level embodied action semantic reasoning, exhibiting profound physical understanding and robust generalization across unseen scenarios.
tldr: VIDEAS distills explicit action semantics from demonstration videos into structured knowledge validated by a prior-guided simulation, and trains language-based world models (VIDEAS-WM) that achieve state-of-the-art high-level embodied reasoning.
tldr_zh: VIDEAS利用先验引导的仿真机制，从演示视频中提炼显式动作语义，并训练基于语言的世界模型（VIDEAS-WM），在高层具身推理中达到最先进性能。
summary_zh: 世界模型通过学习环境动态的内部表征来预测未来状态，从而使智能体无需物理交互即可优化行动计划。然而，如何构建能够真正内化潜在因果物理规律、并显式推理动作前置条件及后续状态转换的世界模型，仍是一个悬而未决的挑战。为此，本文提出VIDEAS框架，一种数据蒸馏方法，将操作视频中的连续物理动态转化为基础模型的显式动作语义。具体而言，该框架将视觉演示解构为离散的动作轨迹，并利用先进视觉-语言模型（VLMs）提取包含动作前置条件与效果的结构化知识。为确保物理一致性，我们引入一种基于文本环境的先验引导轨迹模拟机制，对所提取的知识进行严格验证。值得注意的是，我们引入负轨迹以增强知识完整性，并通过提升数据多样性来缓解认知偏差。此外，我们发布了VIDEAS-WM，一个基于AgiBot-World数据集训练的8B/9B参数量语言世界模型套件，包含34K个高质量样本。大量实验表明，VIDEAS-WM在高层次具身动作语义推理任务上达到了最先进的性能，展现出深刻的物理理解能力及在未见场景中稳健的泛化能力。

title: Recursive Harness Distillation across Agents for Robot Manipulation
summary: A central goal in robotics is to enable manipulation across changing tasks and environments. Vision-language-action (VLA) models provide broad manipulation capabilities but can struggle when execution requires diagnosing failures and adapting behavior. Strong agents can discover effective interventions through interaction with these policies. We propose Recursive Harness Distillation to accumulate this experience as reusable guidance across agents. A strong agent distills its experience into a playbook for a light agent, then recursively refines the playbook using the light agent's execution feedback. The resulting playbook enables agents to reuse accumulated intervention knowledge in new task instances without updating model parameters. In real-world manipulation, the harness improves success from 37.3% to 64.0%. On SimplerEnv Bridge, the light agent with the playbook achieves 66.7% success, compared with 41.7% for the GR00T-only baseline, and outperforms the strong agent without a playbook. The same playbook also benefits the strong agent, which reaches 79.2% success. These results demonstrate the feasibility of harness distillation for robotics: intervention experience can be accumulated, refined through execution, and reused across agents to improve manipulation.
tldr: This paper introduces Recursive Harness Distillation, a method that distills intervention experience from a strong agent into a reusable playbook for a light agent, recursively refining it through execution feedback to improve robot manipulation success across tasks without model parameter updates.
tldr_zh: 本文提出递归吊带蒸馏方法，将强智能体的干预经验蒸馏为可复用的操作手册，并通过执行反馈递归优化，以在不更新模型参数的情况下提升机器人操作的跨任务成功率。
summary_zh: 机器人学的核心目标之一是实现跨任务和跨环境的操作能力。视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型提供了广泛的操作能力，但在执行过程中需要诊断失败并调整行为时，这些模型可能面临困难。强大的智能体可以通过与这些策略的交互发现有效的干预措施。我们提出了递归驾驭蒸馏（Recursive Harness Distillation）方法，将这种经验积累为可跨智能体复用的指导性知识。一个强大的智能体将其经验蒸馏为轻量级智能体的操作手册，然后利用轻量级智能体的执行反馈递归地优化该手册。所生成的手册使智能体能够在新的任务实例中复用积累的干预知识，而无需更新模型参数。在真实世界操作中，该驾驭机制将成功率从37.3%提升至64.0%。在SimplerEnv Bridge上，配备手册的轻量级智能体达到了66.7%的成功率，而仅使用GR00T基线的成功率为41.7%，并且其表现优于未配备手册的强智能体。同一手册也使强大智能体受益，使其成功率达到了79.2%。这些结果证明了驾驭蒸馏在机器人领域的可行性：干预经验可以被积累、通过执行进行优化，并在不同智能体之间复用，从而提升操作性能。

title: CompliantWBC: Whole-Body Compliance for Heavy Humanoids via Force Latent Estimation and Residual Impedance Targets
summary: Whole-body compliant control is essential for deploying heavy humanoids under high payload in human-centric environments. Most prior force-aware learning-based pipelines focus on end-effector resistance, per-link upper-body springs, or end-effector stiffness modulation, leaving arbitrary-site perturbations on heavy platforms with lower-body engagement largely unaddressed. We close this gap with CompliantWBC comprising: (1) A base policy trained with RL to maximize compliance-fidelity reward, guided by a multi-site whole-body impedance reference controller, extending classical Cartesian impedance to any controlled link; (2) A bounded residual policy that edits the per-link impedance equilibrium over a frozen base, correcting the coarse but structured wrench estimate supplied by a force encoder co-trained behind a gradient barrier; (3) A Phong-weighted force-origin sampler with an axis-decoupled pelvis anchor induces lower-body-inclusive compliance curriculum training via two interpretable parameters. We evaluate CompliantWBC in simulation against both compliant and stiff baselines, achieving best compliant fidelity of 2.58cm deviation from analytical solutions, and demonstrate it on a real heavy humanoid across static/dynamic force reaction, board wiping, squat under payload, and cooperative payload transport. Project website: https://dotandung.github.io/compliantwbc/
tldr: This paper introduces CompliantWBC, a whole-body compliant control framework for heavy humanoid robots, using RL-trained base and residual policies with force latent estimation and impedance targets to handle arbitrary-site perturbations, validated in simulation and on a real heavy humanoid.
tldr_zh: 本文提出CompliantWBC，一种针对重型人形机器人的全身柔顺控制框架，利用强化学习训练的基础策略和残余策略，结合力潜在估计和阻抗目标，处理任意部位扰动，并在仿真和真实重型人形机器人上验证。
summary_zh: 全身柔顺控制对于在高载荷环境下部署重型人形机器人至关重要。现有的大多数基于力感知的学习方法主要关注末端执行器阻抗、连杆上部弹簧或末端执行器刚度调节，而针对重型平台上任意部位扰动且涉及下肢参与的问题仍未得到充分解决。我们通过提出CompliantWBC来填补这一空白，其核心组成包括：（1）一个基于强化学习训练的基础策略，以最大化柔顺保真度奖励为目标，并由多部位全身阻抗参考控制器引导，将经典笛卡尔阻抗扩展到任意受控连杆；（2）一个有界残差策略，在冻结基础策略之上对每个连杆的阻抗平衡点进行编辑，修正由梯度屏障后协同训练的力编码器所提供的粗略但结构化的力旋量估计；（3）一个Phong加权力源采样器，配合轴解耦骨盆锚定，通过两个可解释参数实现包含下肢参与的柔顺课程训练。我们在仿真环境中将CompliantWBC与柔顺基线和刚性基线进行对比评估，在与解析解相比仅2.58厘米偏差的情况下取得了最佳的柔顺保真度，并在真实重型人形机器人上完成了静态/动态力反应、擦板、承载负重下蹲以及协同负重搬运等实验验证。项目网站：https://dotandung.github.io/compliantwbc/

title: AquaWAM: A Dynamics-aware World Action Model for Underwater Embodied Agents
summary: World Action Models (WAMs) are becoming increasingly important and useful for embodied intelligence, as they enable robots to anticipate the consequences of candidate actions before interacting with the physical environment. However, underwater robots are usually subject to passive dynamics, such as inertia, buoyancy, hydrodynamic drag, and persistent drift, which can continue to affect the vehicle even after an action is completed. Existing WAMs, which primarily predict action-conditioned visual observations, are not explicitly designed to capture such passive motion dynamics. In this paper, we present AquaWAM, the first World Action Model designed for underwater embodied agents. Instead of predicting future images, AquaWAM models both action-conditioned and passive physical dynamics, including the thruster dead band, the inertial glide that outlasts each command, and ambient currents. Specifically, it senses through the DVL, IMU, pressure sensor and joint encoders, while cameras supply only semantics for understanding goals and target pose. By modeling compact navigation states rather than high-dimensional visual observations, AquaWAM substantially reduces the model size and computational cost compared with conventional WAMs. Experimentally, AquaWAM achieves a 72.6% task success rate across 20 underwater tasks on the USIM benchmark, outperforming existing methods while making action decisions 2.7x faster than U0 on an NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin. Our model also remains effective when some onboard sensor measurements are unavailable. For example, without DVL velocity measurements, our method still achieves a 61.6% success rate, compared with 39.4% for U0.
tldr: AquaWAM introduces a dynamics-aware world action model for underwater robots, modeling passive physical dynamics and compact navigation states to enable efficient action-conditioned prediction and improved task success on the USIM benchmark.
tldr_zh: AquaWAM 提出了一种面向水下机器人的动力学感知世界动作模型，通过建模被动物理动力学和紧致的导航状态，在 USIM 基准上实现了更高的任务成功率和更快的决策速度。
summary_zh: 世界行动模型（WAMs）在具身智能领域正变得日益重要且实用，因为它们使机器人能够在与物理环境交互之前预判候选行动可能带来的后果。然而，水下机器人通常受到被动动力学的影响，如惯性、浮力、水动力阻力和持续漂移等，这些因素即使在动作执行完毕后仍可能继续作用于运载器。现有的WAMs主要预测以行动为条件的视觉观测结果，并未专门设计用于捕捉此类被动运动动力学。在本文中，我们提出了AquaWAM，这是首个专为水下具身智能体设计的World Action Model。与传统预测未来图像的方法不同，AquaWAM同时对行动条件动力学和被动物理动力学进行建模，包括推进器死区、在每条指令结束后仍持续存在的惯性滑行以及环境海流。具体而言，它通过多普勒测速仪（DVL）、惯性测量单元（IMU）、压力传感器和关节编码器进行感知，而摄像头仅提供语义信息用于理解目标和期望位姿。通过对紧凑的导航状态而非高维视觉观测进行建模，AquaWAM相比传统WAMs大幅减小了模型尺寸和计算成本。实验表明，在USIM基准的20项水下任务中，AquaWAM达到了72.6%的任务成功率，在超越现有方法的同时，在NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin上做出行动决策的速度比U0快2.7倍。此外，当部分船载传感器测量数据不可用时，我们的模型依然保持有效性。例如，在缺少DVL速度测量的情况下，我们的方法仍能达到61.6%的成功率，而U0仅为39.4%。

title: Q-WAM: 4-Bit Quantization of World Action Models with Action-Subspace Protection
summary: World Action Models (WAMs) jointly generate video and robot actions through iterative diffusion and perform strongly in robotic manipulation. However, their prohibitive compute and memory costs pose substantial deployment challenges. Post-training quantization (PTQ) can reduce these costs, but existing PTQ methods such as smoothing and rotation are insufficient to maintain the precision of action generation. To overcome this limitation, we propose Q-WAM, a new 4-bit weight-activation quantization for WAMs that preserves the actions the model generates. Specifically, we introduce the \textit{Action Observability Gramian (AOG)}, which measures how much rounding errors in each weighted combination of a layer's input channels change the final action through all denoising steps. We also develop Action-Subspace Protection (ASP), which keeps the few most action-sensitive channel combinations in a tiny 16-bit low-rank branch and quantizes the complementary weights and activations to 4 bits, both as dense matrix multiplications that run efficiently on GPUs. Finally, to preserve action quality with minimal overhead, we identify the experts that matter most for the generated action by aggregating the AOG-derived action mass across the layers of each expert and apply ASP only to those experts. We evaluate Q-WAM on three WAMs, both in simulation and in real-world deployment. On the RoboTwin 2.0 benchmark, it reaches 89.6--93.0\% average success rate, within 1.1 percentage points of the 16-bit models, while reducing the memory of the quantized blocks by 3.1--3.4$\times$. Our method outperforms the strongest baseline, SVDQuant, by 2.5--8.7 percentage points. On a Unitree G1 humanoid and a bimanual UR3 robot, it improves success over SVDQuant by 12.8-17.6 percentage points.
tldr: This paper introduces Q-WAM, a 4-bit weight-activation quantization method for World Action Models (WAMs) that preserves action generation accuracy by protecting action-sensitive channel combinations via a low-rank 16-bit branch, achieving near-16-bit success rates in simulation and real-world robotic manipulation with significant memory reduction.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了 Q-WAM，一种针对世界动作模型（WAMs）的4位权重-激活量化方法，通过低秩16位分支保护对动作生成敏感的信道组合，在仿真和真实机器人操作中实现了接近16位模型的成功率，同时显著降低内存占用。
summary_zh: 世界动作模型（WAMs）通过迭代扩散联合生成视频和机器人动作，在机器人操作任务中表现出色。然而，其高昂的计算和内存成本带来了巨大的部署挑战。训练后量化（PTQ）可以降低这些成本，但现有的PTQ方法（如平滑和旋转）不足以保持动作生成的精度。为克服这一局限，我们提出Q-WAM，一种面向WAMs的新型4比特权重-激活量化方法，能够保持模型生成的动作不变。具体而言，我们引入了\textit{动作可观测性格拉姆矩阵（AOG）}，用于度量层输入通道每次加权组合中的舍入误差如何通过所有去噪步骤影响最终动作。我们还开发了动作子空间保护（ASP）方法，将少数对动作最敏感的通道组合保留在一个小型16比特低秩分支中，并将互补的权重和激活量化至4比特，两者均以密集矩阵乘法形式在GPU上高效运行。最后，为以最小开销保持动作质量，我们通过聚合每个专家各层中AOG推导出的动作质量分布，识别对生成动作最关键的专家，并仅对这些专家应用ASP。我们在三个WAMs上对Q-WAM进行了评估，涵盖仿真和真实世界部署。在RoboTwin 2.0基准测试中，Q-WAM达到了89.6\%--93.0\%的平均成功率，与16比特模型相差仅1.1个百分点，同时将量化块的显存占用减少了3.1--3.4倍。我们的方法优于最强基线SVDQuant，提升幅度为2.5--8.7个百分点。在宇树G1人形机器人和双臂UR3机器人上，相比SVDQuant，成功率提升了12.8--17.6个百分点。

title: VehDyn: A Driving World Model Benchmark for Vehicle Dynamics
summary: Video world models are emerging as data engines, action planners, and generative simulators for autonomous driving, but existing benchmarks primarily assess visual fidelity and coarse physical plausibility, providing limited evidence on whether generated driving futures obey realistic vehicle kinematics and dynamics. This limitation is further compounded by the lack of datasets in which vehicle, road, maneuver, and speed conditions are independently controlled, and ground-truth vehicle states are recorded in synchrony with videos. We introduce VehDyn, a driving world model benchmark for vehicle dynamics. VehDyn is built on a CARLA-CarSim co-simulation platform where photorealistic rendering is coupled with a validated multi-body dynamics model, and it contains 10,080 configurations from a full factorial design over five vehicle types, four tire-road friction coefficients, three maneuvers, four target speeds, 14 scenes, and three illuminations, each paired with synchronized position, velocity, and attitude sequences. Built on this dataset, VehDyn introduces a hierarchical evaluation framework that measures trajectory alignment, kinematic consistency, and dynamic consistency, and benchmarks 12 state-of-the-art video world models. We further assess the video quality using two established protocols and correlate it with the VehDyn score. Trajectory-level metrics are nearly saturated, with ten of twelve models within 20\% of ground truth, while no model reaches 92\% of ground truth on dynamic consistency, and visual-quality metrics are only weakly correlated with vehicle-dynamics fidelity. DrivingWorld achieves the highest VehDyn score, followed by Cosmos 3 Nano and LTX-Video 2.5, and the VehDyn score agrees closely with human judgment. VehDyn provides a systematic foundation for developing driving world models that are physically consistent and visually realistic.
tldr: VehDyn is a benchmark for evaluating driving world models on vehicle dynamics, built on a CARLA-CarSim co-simulation with 10,080 controlled configurations and a hierarchical evaluation framework.
tldr_zh: VehDyn 是一个基于 CARLA-CarSim 联合仿真平台构建的驾驶世界模型基准，包含 10,080 个受控配置和分层评估框架，用于评估车辆动力学一致性。
summary_zh: 视频世界模型正逐渐成为自动驾驶领域的数据引擎、行动规划器以及生成式模拟器，但现有基准测试主要评估视觉保真度和粗略的物理合理性，对于生成的驾驶未来是否遵循真实的车辆运动学与动力学特性，所能提供的证据十分有限。这一局限性进一步因缺乏车辆、道路、操作动作和速度条件均可独立控制，且真实车辆状态与视频同步记录的数据集而加剧。为此，我们提出了VehDyn——一个面向车辆动力学的驾驶世界模型基准测试。VehDyn基于CARLA-CarSim联合仿真平台构建，在该平台中，逼真渲染与经过验证的多体动力学模型相结合，包含由五种车型、四种轮胎-路面摩擦系数、三种操作动作、四种目标速度、十四个场景和三种光照条件组成的全因子设计所生成的10,080种配置，每种配置均配有同步的位置、速度和姿态序列。基于该数据集，VehDyn引入了一种分层评估框架，用于衡量轨迹一致性、运动学一致性和动力学一致性，并对12种当前最先进的视频世界模型进行了基准测试。我们还使用两种既定协议评估了视频质量，并将其与VehDyn评分进行了相关性分析。结果显示，轨迹级指标已接近饱和，十二个模型中有十个与真实值的差距在20%以内；而没有任何模型在动力学一致性上达到真实值的92%，且视觉质量指标与车辆动力学保真度仅呈弱相关。DrivingWorld取得了最高的VehDyn评分，其次是Cosmos 3 Nano和LTX-Video 2.5，且VehDyn评分与人工判断高度一致。VehDyn为开发兼具物理一致性和视觉真实感的驾驶世界模型提供了系统性的基础。

title: ActionGround: Training-Free Runtime Refinement of Frozen VLA Policies
summary:
Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models map visual observations and language instructions directly to robot actions, but they do not explicitly represent the phase structure of manipulation tasks or the rigid-body dynamics governing execution. We present ActionGround, a neuro-symbolic, training-free runtime layer that wraps a frozen VLA policy without retraining, fine-tuning, or weight access, adding less than 1 ms of overhead per control step. A symbolic phase-aware finite-state machine identifies the manipulation phase (approach, grasp, transport, or place) and applies a phase-specific rule-based correction. In parallel, an always-on, inertia-weighted Euler-Lagrange term incorporates the robot's equations of motion into each control step, while its dynamics residual is logged as a consistency diagnostic rather than used as a gate.
  We evaluate ActionGround across OpenVLA, OpenVLA-OFT, Force-VLA, and Generalist-VLA on ten LIBERO-Spatial pick-and-place tasks using a 7-DoF Franka Panda. With fixed parameters across tasks and backbones, ActionGround improves success rate by up to 6 percentage points and stability by up to 19.3 percentage points, while improving trajectory efficiency by up to 15%. In a separate Robosuite noise sweep, ActionGround provides approximately a 10x improvement in trajectory-jerk robustness under injected action noise. In a matched-seed Robosuite simulation companion to a real Agilex Piper trial, simulated baseline success increases from 35% to 95%. The physical-hardware experiment is presented as a qualitative deployment demonstration; quantitative per-trial success on the real arm is left for future work. Our evaluation is limited to rigid-object pick-and-place manipulation.
tldr: ActionGround is a training-free, neuro-symbolic runtime layer that wraps a frozen VLA policy to improve pick-and-place manipulation by adding phase-aware symbolic corrections and an inertia-weighted Euler-Lagrange dynamics term, without retraining or weight access.
tldr_zh: ActionGround 是一个无需训练、神经符号式的运行时层，通过添加相位感知的符号修正和基于惯性的欧拉-拉格朗日动力学项，在不重新训练或访问权重的情况下，提升冻结的VLA策略在抓取放置操作中的表现。
summary_zh:
视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型直接将视觉观察和语言指令映射为机器人动作，但并未显式表征操作任务的阶段结构或控制执行过程的刚体动力学。我们提出ActionGround，一种神经符号、无需训练的运行时层，它封装冻结的VLA策略，无需重训练、微调或权重访问，每个控制步仅增加不到1毫秒的开销。一个符号化的阶段感知有限状态机识别操作阶段（接近、抓取、搬运或放置），并应用针对具体阶段的规则式修正。与此同时，一个始终开启的、基于惯性加权的欧拉-拉格朗日项将机器人的运动方程纳入每个控制步，其动力学残差作为一致性诊断指标被记录，而非用作门控条件。

我们在十个LIBERO-Spatial抓取-放置任务上，使用7自由度Franka Panda，对OpenVLA、OpenVLA-OFT、Force-VLA和Generalist-VLA进行了ActionGround评估。在跨任务和跨骨干网络使用固定参数的情况下，ActionGround将成功率提升最多6个百分点，稳定性提升最多19.3个百分点，同时轨迹效率提升最多15%。在独立的Robosuite噪声扫描实验中，ActionGround在注入动作噪声下将轨迹抖动鲁棒性提升约10倍。在与真实Agilex Piper试验相匹配的随机种子Robosuite仿真对照中，仿真基准成功率从35%提升至95%。物理硬件实验作为定性部署演示呈现；真实机械臂上的定量逐次试验成功率留待未来工作。我们的评估仅限于刚性物体的抓取-放置操作。

title: SurgFlow: 3D Object-Centric Contact Flow for Surgical Robot Manipulation
summary: Paired video-action demonstrations enable autonomous surgical behavior, but such data is scarce: robots perform roughly 1% of surgeries, while video-only data is abundant. Learning 3D object flow offers an embodiment-agnostic way to utilize video data, but flow alone specifies how an object should move, not where and when the tool should engage it, a distinction that is critical in surgery. We introduce SurgFlow, a framework that learns 3D Object-Centric Contact Flow from stereo surgical video without action labels. For each object point, it predicts a future 3D trajectory and contact scores. We extract targets via 3D tracking and tool-object proximity, train a flow matching generator to predict them, and use predicted contact to trigger grasp and release while optimizing end effector motion from flow. On the da Vinci Research Kit (dVRK), SurgFlow succeeds in 37 of 39 stage evaluations across tissue retraction, bimanual reveal, needle pickup, and handover, outperforming baselines trained on equal data with or without action labels. Zero-shot transfer to a humanoid-based laparoscopic robot achieves 85% and 70% average success under similar and novel camera viewpoints, respectively.
tldr: SurgFlow learns 3D object-centric contact flow from stereo surgical videos to enable surgical robot manipulation without action labels, achieving high success on dVRK and zero-shot transfer to a humanoid laparoscopic robot.
tldr_zh: SurgFlow 从立体手术视频中学习 3D 物体中心接触流，无需动作标签即可实现手术机器人操作，在 dVRK 上取得高成功率，并零样本迁移至人形腹腔镜机器人。
summary_zh: 配对视频-动作演示能够实现自主手术行为，但此类数据十分稀缺：机器人仅执行约1%的手术，而仅包含视频的数据则大量存在。学习3D物体流提供了一种与具体实现无关的方式来利用视频数据，但仅凭流信息只能说明物体应如何移动，无法确定工具应在何处、何时与之交互，而这一区别在手术中至关重要。我们提出了SurgFlow，一个无需动作标签、仅从立体手术视频中学习3D物体中心接触流的框架。对于每个物体点，它预测未来的3D轨迹和接触得分。我们通过3D跟踪和工具-物体接近度提取目标，训练流匹配生成器进行预测，并利用预测的接触信息触发抓取和释放，同时根据流信息优化末端执行器运动。在达芬奇研究套件（dVRK）上，SurgFlow在组织牵拉、双手显露、持针和交接等39个阶段评估中成功完成37项，性能优于在相同数据量下训练、无论是否使用动作标签的基线方法。零样本迁移至类人腹腔镜机器人，在相似和新型相机视角下分别实现了85%和70%的平均成功率。

title: Learning with Object-centric Representations of Tactile Interactive Perception for Robot Manipulation
summary: Implicit object properties that are difficult to directly infer from vision, such as material, container contents, or softness, can be revealed through tactile sensing and exploratory interactions. However, because tactile signals are transient and sparse, extracting informative tactile events and effectively incorporating them into robotic manipulation remains a challenge. In this work, we present an object-centric context-aware manipulation framework that learns task-agnostic object representations through tactile exploration. A token learner autonomously selects representative tactile segments from long-horizon exploration, while contrastive alignment with descriptive text embeddings enables a latent space that captures multiple physical object properties. These learned representations are then used as semantic context to guide object-centric manipulation policies and adapt strategies based on object properties. Experiments show that the learned representations achieve 93% and 84% property estimation accuracy on seen and unseen objects. Evaluated on three tasks involving visually ambiguous objects, i.e. multi-object rearrangement, pouring, and box opening, the proposed framework improves both target selection and property-dependent manipulation adaptation, raising task success, aggregated over all evaluation trials, from 41% to 92% on seen objects and from 19% to 67% on unseen objects over baseline policies without object-context conditioning. Videos and additional results are available at https://xinyiyxyx.github.io/tactile-object-centric/.
tldr: This paper introduces an object-centric, context-aware manipulation framework that learns task-agnostic object representations from tactile exploration via a token learner and contrastive text alignment, improving task success on visually ambiguous manipulation tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种以对象为中心的上下文感知操作框架，通过token学习器和对比文本对齐从触觉探索中学习任务无关的对象表征，提高了视觉模糊操作任务的成功率。
summary_zh: 难以直接从视觉中推断的隐含物体属性，如材质、容器内容物或软硬度，可以通过触觉感知和探索性交互来揭示。然而，由于触觉信号具有瞬时性和稀疏性，提取信息丰富的触觉事件并将其有效融入机器人操作中仍是一项挑战。在本工作中，我们提出了一种以物体为中心的上下文感知操作框架，通过触觉探索学习与任务无关的物体表示。一个标记学习器自主地从长时间探索中选取具有代表性的触觉片段，同时通过与描述性文本嵌入进行对比对齐，构建一个能够捕捉多种物理物体属性的潜在空间。这些学习到的表示随后作为语义上下文，用于引导以物体为中心的操作策略，并根据物体属性调整操作方式。实验表明，学习到的表示在已见物体和未见物体上的属性估计准确率分别达到93%和84%。在涉及视觉模糊物体的三项任务（即多物体重排、倒液和开箱）评估中，所提框架在目标选择及依赖属性的操作适应方面均取得改进，将所有评估试验汇总后的任务成功率从基线策略（无物体上下文条件）的41%提升至已见物体的92%，并从19%提升至未见物体的67%。视频及其他结果可在 https://xinyiyxyx.github.io/tactile-object-centric/ 获取。

title: Scope-WM: Scoped Computation for Efficient Visual World Models
summary: Visual world models enable robotic planning by predicting future observations, but dense latent-state propagation and sample-intensive trajectory optimization incur high inference latency and peak memory usage, limiting real-time deployment on resource-constrained platforms. Existing sparse world-model acceleration methods either rely on unguided token sparsification, which may discard planning-relevant information and restrict achievable sparsity, or introduce heavy auxiliary modules and cumbersome multi-stage training pipelines. In this work, we present Scope-WM, an efficient visual world model that scopes computation to prediction-relevant latent regions and promising action sequences. Scope-WM distills prediction relevance into a lightweight action-conditioned selector and applies full dynamics prediction only to a compact subset of selected tokens. It updates the remaining tokens using a compact summary of foreground states and their changes, allowing the background to perceive foreground dynamics without costly token-to-token interactions. During planning, Scope-WM preserves and reuses high-quality action sequences discovered during the initial MPC search, focusing subsequent search under reduced rollout budgets. The resulting pipeline requires only a one-off selector distillation followed by a single joint training stage for the sparse world model. On the challenging Push-T task, Scope-WM reduces peak GPU memory usage and planning time to $18.1\%$ and $14.3\%$ of those of dense DINO-WM, respectively, corresponding to a $6.97\times$ planning speedup, while maintaining competitive task performance. Further evaluations across five diverse visual planning tasks demonstrate the general applicability of Scope-WM. Code is available at https://github.com/ChunZheng2022/Scope-WM.
tldr: Scope-WM introduces an efficient visual world model that scopes computation to prediction-relevant latent regions and promising action sequences, reducing memory and planning time substantially while maintaining performance on robotic visual planning tasks.
tldr_zh: Scope-WM 提出了一种高效的视觉世界模型，将计算集中在与预测相关的潜在区域和有希望的动作序列上，在保持性能的同时大幅减少内存和规划时间。
summary_zh: 视觉世界模型通过预测未来观测来实现机器人规划，但密集的潜状态传播和样本密集的轨迹优化会导致较高的推理延迟和峰值内存占用，限制了其在资源受限平台上的实时部署。现有的稀疏世界模型加速方法要么依赖无引导的令牌稀疏化，这可能丢弃与规划相关的信息并限制可实现的稀疏程度，要么引入重型辅助模块和繁琐的多阶段训练流程。在本工作中，我们提出了Scope-WM，一种高效的视觉世界模型，将计算范围限定在与预测相关的潜区域和有前景的动作序列上。Scope-WM将预测相关性蒸馏到一个轻量级的动作条件选择器中，并仅对选定的紧凑令牌子集执行完整的动态预测。它利用前景状态及其变化的紧凑摘要更新剩余令牌，使背景能够在无需昂贵的令牌间交互的情况下感知前景动态。在规划过程中，Scope-WM保留并重用初始MPC搜索中发现的高质量动作序列，在减少的展开预算下聚焦后续搜索。由此产生的流程仅需一次选择器蒸馏，随后对稀疏世界模型进行一次联合训练阶段。在具有挑战性的Push-T任务中，Scope-WM将峰值GPU内存使用量和规划时间分别降低到密集DINO-WM的$18.1\%$和$14.3\%$，对应$6.97\times$的规划加速，同时保持具有竞争力的任务性能。跨五个多样化视觉规划任务的进一步评估证明了Scope-WM的广泛适用性。代码可在https://github.com/ChunZheng2022/Scope-WM获取。

title: TAO-DA: Towards Autonomous Operation--A Dual-Arm Vision-Language-Action Model for Coordinated Manipulation
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models provide a unified framework for grounding high-level semantic information into low-level robot actions, enabling scalable robotic manipulation across diverse tasks. However, existing VLA models lack explicit mechanisms to disentangle the states and intents of the two arms, leading to unintended cross-arm interference that degrades task execution success. To address this issue, we propose a symmetric Dual-Arm Expert (DAE) architecture built upon a shared Vision-Language Model (VLM) backbone with decoupled, arm-specific expert towers. Expert selection is carried out through a two-stage dual-arm intent routing scheme, in which experts are routed either by explicit language instructions in the first stage or by implicit visual semantics in the second stage. Moreover, we introduce a lightweight task progress prediction module that leverages cross-attention between the pre-chunk temporal features and semantic representations of proprioceptive and visual observations to accurately estimate frame-wise task completion progress. This module facilitates task progress synchronization to support coordinated scheduling for collaborative multi-robot tasks. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of our model in dual-arm intent routing and the disentanglement of cross-arm interference, and further provide preliminary evidence of emergent skill generalization from single- to dual-arm tasks (as well as the reverse), together with cross-arm motion-domain skill transfer.
tldr: TAO-DA introduces a dual-arm VLA model with a symmetric Dual-Arm Expert architecture and a task progress prediction module to disentangle cross-arm interference and enable coordinated manipulation.
tldr_zh: TAO-DA 提出了一种双机械臂 VLA 模型，通过对称的双臂专家架构和任务进度预测模块来消除双臂间的干扰并实现协调操作。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型为将高层语义信息映射至低层机器人动作提供了统一框架，从而支持跨多种任务的规模化机器人操作。然而，现有的VLA模型缺乏显式机制来解耦双臂的状态与意图，导致意外的跨臂干扰，进而降低任务执行成功率。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一种基于共享视觉-语言模型（VLM）骨干的对称双臂专家（DAE）架构，该架构采用解耦的、按臂区分的专家塔。专家选择通过一种两阶段双臂意图路由方案实现，其中专家在第一阶段由显式语言指令路由，或在第二阶段由隐式视觉语义路由。此外，我们引入了一个轻量级任务进度预测模块，该模块利用预分块时间特征与本体感知及视觉观测的语义表示之间的交叉注意力，准确估计逐帧任务完成进度。该模块支持任务进度同步，从而促进多机器人协作任务中的协调调度。实验结果验证了我们的模型在双臂意图路由和跨臂干扰解耦方面的有效性，并进一步提供了从单臂到双臂任务（以及反向）的技能涌现泛化以及跨臂运动域技能迁移的初步证据。

title: DeltaWAM: Change-Centric Visual Foresight via Delta Tokens for an Efficient World-Action Model
summary: World-Action Models (WAMs) offer visual foresight for robotic manipulation, but pixel-space models repeatedly reconstruct entire future scenes, incurring high computational cost and spatio-temporal redundancy. In physical manipulation, consecutive frames often share most of their visual context; the changes between them are what an action policy needs to anticipate. We introduce DeltaWAM, a change-centric WAM that makes a compact delta token the unit of future prediction. Each token is a single vector encoding changes between consecutive dense DINO feature maps. DeltaWAM builds on DeltaWorld, a latent world model pretrained on large-scale videos, to autoregressively predict one delta token per future frame. A flow-matching action expert then conditions on the predicted transitions and current DINO features, which serve as spatial anchors, to generate action chunks. Trained for 256 GPU hours on two H100 GPUs, DeltaWAM has 0.725B parameters and achieves 92.8% average success on LIBERO. It also shows robust generalization under procedural perturbations on LIBERO-Pro. Inference takes 142.1 ms per action chunk with 3.86 GB peak memory.
tldr: DeltaWAM introduces a change-centric world-action model that predicts compact delta tokens representing changes between consecutive DINO feature maps, enabling efficient visual foresight and action generation for robotic manipulation. It achieves high success on LIBERO with low inference cost.
tldr_zh: DeltaWAM 提出了一种以变化为中心的世界动作模型，通过预测连续DINO特征图之间的紧凑变化标记来生成视觉预期和动作，从而在LIBERO上实现了高成功率并降低了推理成本。
summary_zh: 世界-动作模型（WAMs）为机器人操作提供了视觉预见能力，但像素空间的模型会反复重建整个未来场景，导致高昂的计算成本和时空冗余。在物理操作中，连续帧之间通常共享大部分视觉上下文；动作策略需要预判的正是这些帧之间的变化。我们提出DeltaWAM，一种以变化为中心的WAM，将紧凑的增量标记作为未来预测的基本单元。每个标记是一个单一向量，编码连续稠密DINO特征图之间的变化。DeltaWAM基于DeltaWorld——一个在大规模视频上预训练的潜在世界模型——自回归地预测每个未来帧的一个增量标记。随后，一个流匹配动作专家以预测的转变和当前DINO特征（作为空间锚点）为条件，生成动作块。DeltaWAM在两张H100 GPU上训练256个GPU小时，拥有7.25亿参数，在LIBERO基准上达到92.8%的平均成功率。在LIBERO-Pro的程序化扰动下，它展现出稳健的泛化能力。推理每个动作块耗时142.1毫秒，峰值内存占用3.86 GB。

title: Multi-Terrain Mastery: A Comprehensive Controller for Bipedal Locomotion
summary: Advancing bipedal robots to navigate diverse terrains remains a significant challenge in robotics. Traditional locomotion controllers excel on specific surfaces but struggle across varied environments, limiting their practical applications. Given the unpredictable nature of real-world environments, a single controller capable of handling multiple terrains is ideal, eliminating the need for multiple specialized controllers. We propose a multi-terrain controller to enhance the versatility and robustness of bipedal locomotion. Building on previous work with a stance ankle motor for stability on inclined and rough surfaces, this paper extends capabilities to steep wet uneven grassy slopes, and compliant terrains such as sand, gravel, rocks, and constrained terrains like staircases. To address the unique demands of these terrains, we introduce a new impact map that is essential for maintaining performance and robustness against unseen terrains. We also discuss in detail the control structure for real-time deployment on the robot. We validate our controller on the 20 degree-of-freedom Cassie bipedal robot.
tldr: This paper presents a multi-terrain controller for the Cassie bipedal robot, extending prior work to handle steep wet grassy slopes, compliant terrains, and staircases via a new impact map and detailed real-time control structure, validated on the 20-DOF robot.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种针对Cassie双足机器人的多地形控制器，通过新的冲击图和实时控制结构，将其能力扩展到陡峭湿滑草坡、沙地、碎石等柔性地形以及楼梯，并在20自由度机器人上进行了验证。
summary_zh: 推进双足机器人适应多样化地形导航仍是机器人学中的重大挑战。传统运动控制器在特定表面上表现出色，但在多样环境中则力有不逮，从而限制了其实际应用。鉴于现实环境不可预测的特性，一个能应对多种地形的单一控制器成为理想选择，无需配备多个专用控制器。我们提出一种多地形控制器，旨在增强双足运动的多样性与稳健性。基于先前工作中利用踝关节支撑电机在倾斜及粗糙表面上的稳定性研究，本文进一步扩展能力至陡峭湿滑的不平草地斜坡，以及沙地、砾石、岩石等顺应性地形，还有楼梯等受限地形。为应对这些地形的独特需求，我们引入一种新的碰撞映射，该映射对维持针对未知地形的性能与稳健性至关重要。我们还详细讨论了用于机器人实时部署的控制结构。我们在具有20个自由度的Cassie双足机器人上验证了我们的控制器。

title: Dynamic Manipulation with World-Action Models via Counterfactual Planning
summary:
World-Action models (WAMs) trained on static demonstrations often fail to manipulate moving targets even when they possess the required manipulation skills. We attribute this failure to target-response collapse: as execution advances, the policy becomes increasingly biased toward the learned continuation of its ongoing behavior and less responsive to target relocation.
  To bridge the gap between what the model has learned and what it can generate from the current context, we formulate dynamic manipulation as counterfactual planning by decoupling the context used for plan generation from the physical state used for execution. Our framework, Dynamic Predictive Planning (DPP), first uses the WAM's predictive rollout to estimate when an interaction is expected to occur, and combines this timing estimate with observed target motion to predict the target's future interaction position. DPP then constructs a counterfactual observation that places this predicted target position in a familiar robot context, allowing the model to invoke an existing manipulation skill rather than generate a recovery behavior from an unfamiliar robot-target configuration. The resulting plan is connected to the robot's actual state during execution.
  DPP enables real-time dynamic manipulation on a single consumer GPU without additional training on dynamic data. Experiments in simulation and on a real robot demonstrate consistent improvements across diverse target motions, with simulation performance surpassing all evaluated baselines, including methods additionally trained on dynamic data.
  Project page: https://methoder00.github.io/DPP/
tldr: This paper introduces Dynamic Predictive Planning (DPP), a framework that enables world-action models trained on static demonstrations to perform real-time dynamic manipulation of moving targets by decoupling plan generation from physical execution and using counterfactual planning, achieving state-of-the-art results in simulation and on a real robot without additional training on dynamic data.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了动态预测规划（DPP）框架，通过将计划生成与物理执行解耦并使用反事实规划，使在静态演示上训练的世界-动作模型能够实时操纵移动目标，在仿真和真实机器人上均取得最佳效果，且无需对动态数据进行额外训练。
summary_zh:
在静态演示上训练的世界动作模型（WAMs）即便具备所需的操作技能，也往往无法操控移动目标。我们将这一失败归因于“目标—响应坍缩”：随着执行的推进，策略越来越偏向于其当前行为的已学习延续，而对目标位置变化的响应性逐渐减弱。

为弥合模型已学内容与其在当前上下文中可生成内容之间的差距，我们将动态操作表述为反事实规划，将用于规划生成的上下文与用于执行的物理状态解耦。我们的框架——动态预测规划（DPP）——首先利用WAM的预测性 rollout 来估计预期发生交互的时间，并将该时间估计与观测到的目标运动相结合，以预测目标未来的交互位置。随后，DPP 构造一个反事实观测，将该预测的目标位置置于一个熟悉的机器人上下文中，从而使模型能够调用已有的操作技能，而非从不熟悉的机器人—目标构型中生成恢复行为。所生成的规划在执行过程中与机器人的实际状态相连接。

DPP 可在单块消费级 GPU 上实现实时动态操作，且无需在动态数据上进行额外训练。仿真实验与真实机器人实验均表明，在多样化的目标运动场景下，DPP 均取得了一致的性能提升，其仿真性能超越了所有评估基线，包括额外在动态数据上训练的方法。

项目页面：https://methoder00.github.io/DPP/

title: TimelyDAgger: Timing-Aware Expert Querying for VLA Policy Improvement
summary: DAgger improves robot policies by aggregating expert supervision from states visited during policy execution. Robot-gated DAgger automates expert queries, allowing the robot to decide when to request expert takeover. While existing gates emphasize detecting the need for assistance, takeover timing also shapes the content of these demonstrations and their value for policy learning. We propose TimelyDAgger, combining Bridge-PCA monitoring of internal vision-language-action (VLA) features with Feedback-guided Threshold Adaptation based on expert behavior to improve takeover timing. We introduce an evaluation framework linking failure detection, takeover timing, and policy improvement, including Target-Aligned Supervision Ratio (TASR) for assessing supervision quality without retraining. Experiments show that takeover timing affects policy learning, with TimelyDAgger achieving competitive failure detection and higher post-training success in most evaluated settings under matched expert-action budgets.
tldr: TimelyDAgger improves DAgger-style robot policy learning by introducing timing-aware expert querying, using Bridge-PCA on VLA features and Feedback-guided Threshold Adaptation to decide when to request expert takeover, and shows that better takeover timing yields higher post-training success under matched expert-action budgets.
tldr_zh: TimelyDAgger通过基于VLA特征的Bridge-PCA和基于专家行为的反馈引导阈值自适应来优化DAgger式机器人策略学习中的专家接管时机，在相同专家动作预算下实现了更好的策略提升。
summary_zh: 摘要：DAgger通过聚合策略执行过程中所访问状态下的专家监督来改进机器人策略。机器人门控DAgger实现了专家查询的自动化，使机器人能够自主决定何时请求专家接管。尽管现有门控机制侧重于检测辅助需求，但接管时机同样会影响示范内容及其对策略学习的价值。我们提出TimelyDAgger，将内部视觉-语言-动作（VLA）特征的Bridge-PCA监测与基于专家行为的反馈引导阈值自适应相结合，以改善接管时机。我们引入了一个评估框架，将故障检测、接管时机和策略改进联系起来，并包含目标对齐监督比（TASR），以便在不重新训练的情况下评估监督质量。实验表明，接管时机影响策略学习效果，在匹配专家动作预算的条件下，TimelyDAgger在大多数评估场景中实现了具有竞争力的故障检测性能，并在训练后取得了更高的成功率。

title: VPTwin: Real-Sim-Real Video Prediction for Robotic Manipulation Planning
summary: While action-conditioned video prediction provides an intuitive world model for robotics, purely data-driven predictors often suffer from compounding errors and physically implausible hallucinations in long-horizon rollouts, severely undermining downstream action planning. We propose VPTwin, a Real-Sim-Real video prediction framework that anchors real-world future prediction using real-synchronized simulation twins. For a target manipulation task, a VLM reconstructs an executable digital twin from a real demonstration episode. To accommodate the ill-posed estimation of unobserved physical properties, Isaac Sim simulates multiple forward dynamic rollouts across randomized physical configurations under candidate action trajectories. Using these rollouts as in-context references, VPTwin harmonizes both domains, using simulation dynamics to enforce physical plausibility while capturing unmodeled contact interactions from real video. Furthermore, we establish a predictive planning loop using VPTwin to visually verify VLM-proposed actions and guide reliable real-world execution. Evaluations show substantial reductions in physical hallucinations during video prediction and marked improvements in manipulation planning performance.
tldr: VPTwin proposes a Real-Sim-Real video prediction framework for robotic manipulation planning, using simulation twins generated by VLMs to enforce physical plausibility and improve downstream action planning.
tldr_zh: VPTwin 提出了一种用于机器人操作规划的 Real-Sim-Real 视频预测框架，利用 VLM 生成的仿真孪生来增强物理合理性并改善下游动作规划。
summary_zh: 摘要：尽管基于动作条件的视频预测为机器人技术提供了一种直观的世界模型，但纯数据驱动的预测器在长期推演中常常遭受累积误差和物理上不合理的幻觉问题，严重影响了下游动作规划的性能。我们提出了VPTwin，一种真实-仿真-真实视频预测框架，利用真实同步的仿真孪生体来锚定现实世界的未来预测。对于目标操作任务，视觉语言模型（VLM）从真实演示片段中重建一个可执行的数字孪生体。为应对未观测物理属性估计的不适定问题，Isaac Sim在候选动作轨迹下，对随机化物理配置进行多次前向动力学推演。以这些推演结果作为上下文参考，VPTwin协调两个领域，利用仿真动力学来强制物理合理性，同时从真实视频中捕捉未建模的接触交互。此外，我们建立了一个基于VPTwin的预测规划循环，以视觉验证VLM提出的动作并指导可靠的真实世界执行。评估结果显示，在视频预测中物理幻觉显著减少，操作规划性能明显提升。

title: What Must a World Model Distinguish for Planning?
summary: World models simulate the consequences of action candidates, but good planning need not preserve every physical distinction required for accurate prediction. We formalize this gap through a hierarchy of mechanism, response, and decision sufficiency. Given a candidate set, the planning query determines which physical variations matter and how precisely they must be preserved: coarse decisions can discard much of the information needed for prediction, whereas fine decisions may require nearly the same resolution. In practice, planners often adaptively search to construct candidates, and information unnecessary for final selection may still be needed to discover good candidates. What a world model must preserve therefore depends on the query, the candidate set, and the planner. We study these effects in a collision system, nonlinear dynamics, and robotic planning. These varying requirements raise a design question: where should query information enter the planning system? A model that jointly generates actions and outcomes conditioned on the query achieves lower regret than an action-conditioned world model on seen objectives, but this advantage largely disappears when generalizing to unseen objectives. Motivated by this, we propose a modular design in which the query determines where to look and an action-conditioned model predicts what will happen, allowing the same predictions to be reused across objectives.
tldr: This paper formalizes the gap between world model prediction accuracy and planning performance by introducing a hierarchy of mechanism, response, and decision sufficiency, and proposes a modular planner-world-model design where the query determines where to look and an action-conditioned model predicts outcomes, improving regret on seen objectives while generalizing to unseen ones.
tldr_zh: 本文通过提出机制、响应和决策充分性的层次结构，正式化了世界模型预测准确性与规划性能之间的差距，并提出了一种模块化设计，其中查询决定关注点，动作条件模型预测结果，在已见目标上降低遗憾，并在未见目标上保持泛化。
