summary_zh: 世界模型模拟候选动作的后果，但优秀的规划并不需要保留准确预测所需的每一个物理区别。我们通过机制充分性、响应充分性和决策充分性的层级结构来形式化这一差距。给定候选集合，规划查询决定了哪些物理变化至关重要，以及这些变化必须以何种精度被保留：粗粒度的决策可以舍弃预测所需的大量信息，而细粒度的决策则可能要求几乎相同的分辨率。在实践中，规划器通常通过自适应搜索来构建候选，而最终选择所不需要的信息，可能仍然是发现优质候选所必需的。因此，世界模型必须保留什么，取决于查询、候选集合以及规划器。我们在碰撞系统、非线性动力学和机器人规划中研究了这些效应。这些各异的需求引出了一个设计问题：查询信息应从哪里进入规划系统？一个以查询为条件、联合生成动作和结果的模型，在已见目标上比以动作条件的世界模型实现了更低的遗憾值，但在泛化到未见目标时，这一优势基本消失。基于此，我们提出了一种模块化设计，其中查询决定何处聚焦，动作条件模型预测将要发生什么，从而使相同的预测能够跨目标复用。

title: CAPEX: Efficiently Distilling Foundation Model Behavior into Deployable Robot Policies through Experience-Adaptive Reasoning
summary: Robot learning has largely relied on human-teleoperated demonstrations to acquire effective learnable behaviors. However, human-operated data collection processes can be unintuitive, difficult to scale, and inherently asynchronous. We explore an alternative: distilling physical behavior from general-purpose multimodal foundation models into deployable robot policies by using the foundation model itself as an autonomous demonstrator. While sufficiently capable models can generate successful zero-shot manipulation trajectories, repeatedly invoking them during physical execution is slow and expensive, limiting their utility as scalable data generators. As a solution, we introduce CAPEX, an experience-conditioned demonstration collection framework that uses execution experience from previous attempts to adapt how frequently the foundation model must observe, reason, and replan. We evaluate across RoboCasa tasks and on physical Franka and bimanual YAM-arm platforms, measuring task success, model calls, token usage, collection time, and cost. We further train Diffusion Policy and ACT on matched sets of human-teleoperated and foundation-model-generated demonstrations to evaluate the downstream learning value of autonomously collected data. We find that CAPEX increases the number of successful demonstrations by 4.3x while reducing the cost per successful demonstration by 80%. Policies trained on CAPEX-generated data approach the performance of those trained on matched human demonstrations; with longer training, this gap largely closes for policies trained from scratch. These results suggest that foundation models can serve as scalable sources of reusable robot experience. Project page: https://capex-paper.github.io/
tldr: CAPEX uses a multimodal foundation model as an autonomous demonstrator, adapting its reasoning frequency based on execution experience to generate robot demonstrations more efficiently, reducing cost by 80% and improving successful demonstrations by 4.3x while remaining competitive with human demonstrations for policy training.
tldr_zh: CAPEX利用多模态基础模型作为自主演示者，根据执行经验调整推理频率，以更高效地生成机器人演示，成本降低80%，成功演示增加4.3倍，且训练策略与人类演示相当。
summary_zh: 机器人学习在很大程度上依赖于人类遥操作演示来获取有效的可学习行为。然而，人工操作的数据收集过程可能不够直观、难以扩展，且本质上具有异步性。我们探索一种替代方案：利用通用多模态基础模型本身作为自主演示者，将物理行为从模型中蒸馏到可部署的机器人策略中。虽然足够强大的模型能够生成成功的零样本操作轨迹，但在物理执行过程中反复调用这些模型既缓慢又昂贵，限制了其作为可扩展数据生成器的实用性。为此，我们提出CAPEX，一种基于经验条件的演示收集框架，利用先前尝试的执行经验来动态调整基础模型需要观察、推理和重新规划的频率。我们在RoboCasa任务以及物理Franka和双臂YAM-arm平台上进行评估，衡量任务成功率、模型调用次数、令牌使用量、收集时间和成本。此外，我们在匹配的人类遥操作演示和基础模型生成演示数据集上分别训练Diffusion Policy和ACT，以评估自主收集数据的下游学习价值。实验发现，CAPEX将成功演示数量提升了4.3倍，同时将每次成功演示的成本降低了80%。基于CAPEX生成数据训练的策略性能接近基于匹配人类演示训练的策略；随着训练时间的延长，对于从零训练的策略，这一差距基本消失。这些结果表明，基础模型可以作为可扩展的可复用机器人经验来源。项目主页：https://capex-paper.github.io/

title: TriDrive: Joint Driver, Vehicle, and Road Modeling for Forecasting and Driver Monitoring
summary: Predicting how drivers, vehicles, and road scenes interact and evolve together is central to driver monitoring. Prior work models in-cabin activity or traffic-conditioned driver motion in isolation, motivating joint driver, vehicle, and road modeling with real-time on-vehicle evaluation. We introduce TriDrive, to our knowledge the first unified framework that jointly forecasts driver kinematics, vehicle dynamics, and road demands through an automation-conditioned transition model. Modality-specific encoders (an anchored kinematic representation of the driver, causal CAN-bus dynamics, and frozen V-JEPA 2 road latents with structured road margins) are connected by directed residual connections through which driver and road context refine vehicle forecasts. We evaluate TriDrive on three downstream tasks. On the public AIDE benchmark, its kinematic encoder recipe sets a new full-set state of the art (SOTA) among published baselines (48.05 versus 71.47 All-MPJPE). On 197.2 hours of naturalistic BATON subset, directed connections and road margins raise assistance-engaged PR-AUC by 0.084 for steering onset and 0.286 for time-to-collision drops. For real-time use, we distill the road encoders and run TriDrive on a comma four with an external 8 GB GPU, where a lightweight current-state warning probe updates at 5 Hz with 177 ms p95 latency while the joint model forecasts concurrently. The probe is above an openpilot-based baseline on human-labeled manual-driving warnings (AUROC 0.725 versus 0.563), and in a paired on-road study 14 drivers rate its warnings as more appropriate (+1.79) and timely (+2.67) than those of openpilot's driver-monitoring system.
tldr: TriDrive is a unified framework that jointly forecasts driver kinematics, vehicle dynamics, and road demands using an automation-conditioned transition model, achieving SOTA on the AIDE benchmark and improved driver-monitoring performance in real-time on-vehicle evaluation.
tldr_zh: TriDrive 是一个统一框架，通过自动化条件转换模型联合预测驾驶员运动学、车辆动力学和道路需求，在 AIDE 基准上达到 SOTA，并在实时车载评估中改善了驾驶员监控性能。
summary_zh: 预测驾驶员、车辆与道路场景之间如何交互并共同演化，是驾驶员监控的核心问题。已有工作往往孤立地对车内活动或交通条件下的驾驶员运动进行建模，这促使我们开展结合驾驶员、车辆与道路的联合建模，并在实车上进行实时评估。我们提出了TriDrive，据我们所知，这是首个通过自动化条件转移模型，联合预测驾驶员运动学、车辆动力学与道路需求的统一框架。各模态特定的编码器（驾驶员的锚定运动学表示、因果CAN总线动力学、以及带有结构化道路边界的冻结V-JEPA 2道路潜变量）通过有向残差连接相连，从而使驾驶员与道路上下文能够优化车辆预测。我们在三个下游任务上对TriDrive进行了评估。在公开的AIDE基准上，其运动学编码器方案在已发表基线中刷新了全量级最先进水平（All-MPJPE为48.05，对比71.47）。在197.2小时的自然驾驶BATON子集上，有向连接与道路边界使辅助介入的转向起始PR-AUC提高了0.084，碰撞时间下降的PR-AUC提高了0.286。在实时应用方面，我们对道路编码器进行了蒸馏，并在配备外接8 GB GPU的comma four上运行TriDrive，其中轻量级当前状态预警探针以5 Hz频率更新，p95延迟为177 ms，同时联合模型并行进行预测。该探针在人工标注的手动驾驶警告上优于基于openpilot的基线（AUROC为0.725，对比0.563），在一项配对实车研究中，14名驾驶员对其警告的合适性（+1.79）和及时性（+2.67）评价均高于openpilot的驾驶员监控系统。

title: Scanning While Imagining: A Scene-Graph World Model for Robotic Ultrasound Navigation
summary: Ultrasound (US) acquisition depends on the operator's ability to interpret anatomy and anticipate how the view will change with probe motion. Many robotic US navigation methods select actions without explicitly predicting these anatomical changes. We propose SonoGraph-WM, an action- and goal-conditioned world model for anticipatory probe navigation. The model represents anatomy as scene graphs (SGs), capturing visible structures, their geometry, and spatial relationships without synthesizing US images. Given a history of SGs and probe poses, a unified Transformer jointly predicts future SGs and poses. A receding-horizon planner recursively imagines candidate trajectories, selects the shortest predicted path reaching a goal graph, and follows it over a short execution horizon before replanning from new observations. To reduce reliance on tracked and anatomically annotated US sequences, we generate aligned SG--pose training data from computed tomography (CT) label maps along surface-constrained probe trajectories. On four held-out CT cases, spatial relation F1 remains above 93% over 20 prediction steps, and closed-loop navigation achieves 77.50% and 75.00% success for the gallbladder and pancreas, respectively, using annotation-derived SGs. In robot--phantom navigation experiments with label-map-derived SGs, the planner reached the target view in 73.7% of trials. These findings support CT-supervised anatomical world modeling for probe planning and highlight the importance of frequent observation updates for reliable navigation. Project Page: https://noseefood.github.io/us-sonograph-wm/
tldr: This paper introduces SonoGraph-WM, a scene-graph world model that predicts future anatomical structures and probe poses for robotic ultrasound navigation, using CT-derived training data and a receding-horizon planner to achieve anticipatory probe control.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了SonoGraph-WM，一种场景图世界模型，用于预测未来的解剖结构和探头位姿，实现机器人超声导航的预期性控制，并利用CT派生数据进行训练。
summary_zh: 超声（US）图像采集依赖于操作者对解剖结构的解读能力，以及预判随探头运动视野将如何变化的能力。许多机器人超声导航方法在选择动作时并未显式预测这些解剖结构的变化。我们提出SonoGraph-WM，一种用于预判式探头导航的动作与目标条件化世界模型。该模型将解剖结构表示为场景图（SGs），捕获可见结构、其几何形状及空间关系，而无需合成超声图像。给定场景图与探头位姿的历史序列，一个统一的Transformer联合预测未来的场景图与位姿。采用滚动时域规划器递归地推演候选轨迹，选择能够到达目标图的最短预测路径，并在短执行周期内沿该路径运动，随后根据新的观测重新规划。为减少对带追踪且含解剖标注的超声序列的依赖，我们利用CT标签图沿表面约束的探头轨迹生成对齐的场景图-位姿训练数据。在四个留出CT病例上，空间关系F1值在20个预测步内保持在93%以上；基于标注派生场景图的闭环导航对胆囊和胰腺分别达到77.50%和75.00%的成功率。在基于标签图派生场景图的机器人-体模导航实验中，规划器在73.7%的试验中成功到达目标视野。上述结果支持了以CT监督的解剖世界建模用于探头规划，并凸显了频繁的观测更新对可靠导航的重要性。项目主页：https://noseefood.github.io/us-sonograph-wm/

title: ForeFly: A Dual-Horizon World Action Model for Aerial Vision-Language Navigation
summary: Aerial Vision-Language Navigation (AVLN) requires UAVs to maintain reliable instruction following over long trajectories in complex 3D environments. However, existing AVLN approaches are predominantly reactive or limited to single-horizon prediction, overlooking complementary future cues across different temporal horizons. To address this limitation, we propose ForeFly, a dual-horizon latent world action model that predicts both a proximal future for local continuity and an adaptive route-critical future for long-range guidance. Horizon-specific foresight queries are primed with recent and route-critical visual memories, providing history-aware context for future prediction. To exploit their distinct roles in action generation, we introduce Foresight-Guided Action Refinement (FGAR), which asymmetrically exploits proximal foresight for local action enhancement and route-critical foresight for feature-wise correction and route-level guidance. Experiments on the TravelUAV and UAV-ON benchmarks show that ForeFly consistently outperforms strong baselines across seen and unseen settings, validating the effectiveness of dual-horizon foresight and FGAR learning. The code is available at: https://github.com/kunhuiW/ForeFly
tldr: ForeFly introduces a dual-horizon latent world action model for aerial vision-language navigation, predicting both proximal and route-critical futures to guide UAV action generation, achieving state-of-the-art results on TravelUAV and UAV-ON benchmarks.
tldr_zh: ForeFly提出了一种用于空中视觉语言导航的双视野潜在世界动作模型，通过预测近期和路线关键的未来来引导无人机动作生成，在TravelUAV和UAV-ON基准上取得了最先进的结果。
summary_zh: 摘要：航空视觉语言导航（AVLN）要求无人机在复杂的三维环境中沿长轨迹保持可靠的指令跟随能力。然而，现有的AVLN方法主要采用反应式策略或局限于单时间域预测，忽视了不同时间域之间互补的未来线索。为解决这一局限，我们提出了ForeFly，一种双时间域潜在世界动作模型，该模型同时预测用于局部连续性的近期未来和用于远距离引导的自适应路径关键未来。不同时间域的预见性查询以近期和路径关键的视觉记忆为初始输入，从而为未来预测提供具有历史感知的上下文。为利用二者在动作生成中的不同作用，我们引入了预见引导的动作细化机制（FGAR），该机制非对称地利用近期预见进行局部动作增强，以及路径关键预见进行特征级修正和路径级引导。在TravelUAV和UAV-ON基准上的实验表明，ForeFly在已知和未知场景下均持续优于强基线方法，验证了双时间域预见及FGAR学习的有效性。代码已开源至：https://github.com/kunhuiW/ForeFly

title: Hamiltonian JEPA: Action-Conditioned World Models with an Inherited Control State
summary: Planning from pixels needs more than a latent space that is stable and predictable. The state the planner scores must also be organized by how actions move the system. Joint-embedding predictive architectures (JEPAs) avoid pixel reconstruction by predicting future representations, but existing action-conditioned JEPAs ask one embedding to serve both perception and control. We introduce H-JEPA, which separates the two. A wide perceptual code is regularized toward a well-scaled isotropic geometry with a Bures-Wasserstein prior, and a fixed orthonormal slice of that code is the control state, which inherits the code's covariance without any objective of its own. The state evolves under phase-conditioned dissipative port-Hamiltonian dynamics whose input port has orthonormal columns. Port-inverse consistency (PIC) reads the executed action back through the transpose of that port. We show that this readout is exactly the rollout error projected onto the port directions, so PIC is a parameter-free reweighting of prediction error and not an auxiliary action decoder. Untying the readout from the port breaks this identity and loses half of the gain. H-JEPA matches or exceeds reconstruction-free baselines, including the action-decoding Delta-JEPA, on four pixel-based control benchmarks after at most $10$ training epochs, and its largest gain is on OGB-Cube ($91.9$ against $79.3$ percent). Ablations on PushT and OGB-Cube separate the contributions of the structured predictor, PIC, the prediction horizon, the state rank, and the anti-collapse prior.
tldr: H-JEPA is an action-conditioned world model that separates perceptual and control latent states using port-Hamiltonian dynamics and a parameter-free port-inverse consistency readout, achieving state-of-the-art results on pixel-based control benchmarks with only 10 training epochs.
tldr_zh: H-JEPA 是一种动作条件世界模型，通过端口-哈密顿动力学和参数无关的端口逆一致性读出将感知和控制潜在状态分离，在仅训练 10 个周期的情况下在基于像素的控制基准上取得了最优结果。
summary_zh: 基于像素的规划所需的不只是稳定且可预测的潜空间。规划器所评估的状态还必须依据动作如何驱动系统来组织。联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）通过预测未来表示来避免像素重建，但现有的动作条件JEPA要求同一个嵌入同时服务于感知和控制。我们提出了H-JEPA，将两者分离。一个宽感知编码通过Bures-Wasserstein先验被正则化为具有良好尺度的各向同性几何，该编码的一个固定标准正交切片即控制状态，它继承编码的协方差而无需自身的优化目标。该状态在相位条件耗散端口-哈密顿动力学下演化，其输入端口具有标准正交列。端口逆一致性（PIC）通过该端口的转置回读已执行的动作。我们证明，该回读恰好是投影到端口方向上的展开误差，因此PIC是对预测误差的无参数重加权，而非辅助动作解码器。将回读与端口解耦会破坏该恒等关系，并损失一半的增益。在四个基于像素的控制基准上，H-JEPA在至多$10$个训练周期内达到或超过了无重建基线（包括动作解码的Delta-JEPA），其最大增益出现在OGB-Cube上（$91.9\%$对比$79.3\%$）。在PushT和OGB-Cube上的消融实验区分了结构化预测器、PIC、预测视界、状态秩和防塌缩先验各自的贡献。

title: Downstream-Aware Context Selection for Online In-Context Reinforcement Learning
summary: In-context reinforcement learning (ICRL) enables large language model agents to adapt to new environments using their interaction history without updating model parameters. However, repeatedly conditioning on growing histories can lead to substantial token cost. We propose a bounded-history context-management framework that predicts the task-dependent downstream effect of removing historical interactions to guide history selection and determine a decision-dependent context budget. Formally, our framework uses the full rolling history as a reference. The predictor evaluates removal effects, defines a deletion ordering, and applies a shared selection criterion to determine how much history to retain at each decision. We evaluate the method in closed-loop SUMO driving under held-out in-distribution, unseen-domain, and unseen-route settings, and in ScienceWorld under a continual ICRL protocol. Relative to a baseline using the full context, our method reduces total token usage by 25.7%, 25.8%, and 23.2% across the three driving settings while maintaining comparable closed-loop driving performance. In ScienceWorld, it reduces total token usage by 52.1% compared to full context and uses 30.2% and 37.8% fewer tokens than the Recent and Similarity baselines, respectively, while maintaining performance.
tldr: This paper introduces a bounded-history context-management framework for online in-context reinforcement learning, which predicts the effect of removing historical interactions to select context and determine the context budget, reducing token usage while maintaining performance in SUMO driving and ScienceWorld.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于在线上下文强化学习的有限历史上下文管理框架，通过预测移除历史交互的影响来指导上下文选择和确定预算，在SUMO驾驶和ScienceWorld中降低了约25-52%的令牌使用量，同时保持了性能。
summary_zh: 上下文中的强化学习（ICRL）使大型语言模型智能体能够在不更新模型参数的情况下，利用交互历史适应新环境。然而，反复基于不断增长的历史进行条件化处理可能导致大量令牌消耗。我们提出了一种有界历史上下文管理框架，该框架预测移除历史交互对任务相关的下游影响，以指导历史选择并确定依赖于决策的上下文预算。形式上，我们的框架以完整滚动历史作为参考。预测器评估移除效果，定义删除顺序，并应用共享选择标准来确定每个决策点应保留多少历史。我们在封闭循环SUMO驾驶场景中，分别在分布内保留、未见领域和未见路线设置下评估该方法，并在ScienceWorld中采用持续ICRL协议进行评估。与使用完整上下文的基线相比，我们的方法在三种驾驶设置下分别减少了25.7%、25.8%和23.2%的总令牌使用量，同时保持了相当的封闭循环驾驶性能。在ScienceWorld中，与完整上下文相比，该方法将总令牌使用量减少了52.1%，并且与Recent基线和Similarity基线相比，分别少使用了30.2%和37.8%的令牌，同时保持了性能。

title: Hierarchical Multi-agent Reinforcement Learning for Warehouse Robot Coordination under Communication Loss
summary: In this paper, we propose a hierarchical multi-agent reinforcement learning framework for coordinating robot teams in warehouse environments under communication loss. We partition the robot team into groups, with centralized coordination within each group and distributed coordination across groups. Each group uses a recurrent predictor to estimate unavailable interaction information due to communication loss. A higher-level policy then generates a compact coordination reference that conditions the local control policy within each group. A predictive safety filter evaluates and modifies the proposed controls when they violate safety constraints. Simulation results show improved task completion under communication loss, reduced communication growth as the team size increases, and safe operation in the tested scenarios.
tldr: The paper proposes a hierarchical multi-agent reinforcement learning framework for coordinating warehouse robot teams under communication loss, using group partitioning, recurrent prediction, and safety filters to improve task completion and robustness.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种层次化多智能体强化学习框架，用于在通信丢失情况下协调仓库机器人团队，通过分组、循环预测和安全过滤器提高任务完成率和鲁棒性。
summary_zh: 在本文中，我们提出了一种分层多智能体强化学习框架，用于在通信中断情况下协调仓库环境中的机器人团队。我们将机器人团队划分为若干小组，组内进行集中协调，组间则采用分布式协调。每个小组使用一个循环预测器来估计因通信中断而无法获取的交互信息。随后，上层策略生成紧凑的协调参考，以调节组内局部控制策略。当提议的控制动作违反安全约束时，预测性安全过滤器会对其进行评估并加以修正。仿真结果表明，该框架在通信中断情况下提升了任务完成度，随着团队规模增大，通信量的增长得到抑制，并且在所测试的场景中实现了安全运行。

title: AI-Driven Collaborative Assembly Line Inspection: System Integration and Deployment Challenges
summary: Manual visual inspection on assembly lines is a persistent manufacturing bottleneck: operator fatigue over extended shifts lowers defect-detection rates. This paper presents the design, integration, and field deployment of an AI-assisted collaborative inspection cell at the Silverline kitchen-appliance factory, developed within the AI-PRISM project. The cell couples a Universal Robots UR 10e cobot carrying a machine-vision defect-detection pipeline with a Comau Racer-5 cobot for functional tests, coordinated through ROS 2 Humble on an Ubuntu 22.04 LTS server. Multi-modal data (Basler camera imagery, TIA microphone acoustics, and SPS electrical-safety measurements) are logged locally and visualised in real time with Grafana. We report the practical deployment challenges (close-proximity safety, AI robustness under glare and reflections, ROS 2 namespace collisions across two cobots, and operating-system and dependency issues) together with the engineering solutions adopted, and structure the integration through a four-level Human-Robot Interaction analysis. The deployed cell cuts per-unit quality-check time from 82 s to 61 s (about 25%), raises final-control resource efficiency from 0.75 to 0.88, reduces operator visual-inspection viewing time by 82%, and significantly lowers operator mental demand (p = 0.005, NASA-TLX).
tldr: This paper presents the integration and deployment of an AI-assisted collaborative assembly line inspection cell combining a UR10e cobot with vision-based defect detection and a Comau Racer-5 cobot for functional tests, reporting practical challenges and a 25% reduction in inspection time.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了AI辅助协作装配线检测单元的系统集成与现场部署，该单元结合UR10e协作机器人的视觉缺陷检测与Comau Racer-5协作机器人的功能测试，报告了实际部署挑战并将检测时间缩短25%。
summary_zh: 装配线上的目视人工检测一直是制造业的一个持续性瓶颈：操作员在长时间轮班后出现的疲劳会降低缺陷检出率。本文介绍了在AI-PRISM项目框架下，于Silverline厨房电器工厂设计、集成并现场部署的一个AI辅助协作检测工位。该工位将搭载机器视觉缺陷检测流程的Universal Robots UR 10e协作机器人与执行功能测试的Comau Racer-5协作机器人相结合，通过Ubuntu 22.04 LTS服务器上的ROS 2 Humble进行协调控制。多模态数据（Basler相机图像、TIA麦克风声学信号及SPS电气安全测量数据）在本地记录，并通过Grafana实时可视化。我们报告了实际部署中遇到的挑战（近距离安全、眩光与反射条件下的AI鲁棒性、两台协作机器人之间的ROS 2命名空间冲突，以及操作系统和依赖问题），以及所采用的工程解决方案，并通过四级人机交互分析来构建整体集成框架。部署后的检测工位将单件质量检测时间从82秒缩短至61秒（约减少25%），将最终控制资源效率从0.75提升至0.88，操作员目视检测查看时间减少82%，并显著降低了操作员的脑力负荷（p = 0.005，NASA-TLX）。

title: Traceable Human-to-Humanoid Sign Language Benchmarking
summary: Sign data collection is costly, and teleoperation scales poorly, motivating reuse of large video corpora. Humanoid signing requires converting video-derived human motion into robot trajectories while preserving linguistic motion cues. Errors from fitting, human-motion repair, retargeting, robot geometry repair, and control are hard to separate from the final trajectory alone. We introduce HumanoidCSL-20K, a dataset and benchmark of 20,648 sentence-level Chinese Sign Language sequences, each with four aligned versions: the source, the repaired human motion, the direct robot reference, and the geometry-repaired robot reference. Observation-supported local human-motion repair, full-robot geometry repair, and cross-representation provenance make each transformation traceable. Paired evaluations measure human-motion continuity and content preservation, robot-reference feasibility, and physical execution. A sign-specific kinematic-reference protocol scores handshape, location, palm orientation, and inter-hand relation over the full planned motion. Full-corpus results show fewer abnormal arm / hand steps and less inter-hand and hand-body penetration after repair. Control experiments separate reference learnability from curriculum effects, while component scores expose remaining execution errors.
tldr: This paper introduces HumanoidCSL-20K, a benchmark for humanoid Chinese Sign Language generation from videos, with traceable transformations from human motion to robot trajectories and a kinematic-reference evaluation protocol.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了 HumanoidCSL-20K，一个用于从视频生成人形机器人中国手语动作的基准，包含可追溯的人体到机器人轨迹转换过程以及运动学参考评估协议。
summary_zh: 手语数据采集成本高昂，且遥操作的可扩展性有限，这促使研究者利用大规模视频语料库进行复用。类人手语生成需要将视频中提取的人体运动转换为机器人轨迹，同时保留语言学的运动线索。拟合误差、人体运动修复、重定向、机器人几何修复以及控制误差难以仅从最终轨迹中分离出来。我们提出了HumanoidCSL-20K数据集及基准，包含20,648条句子级中国手语序列，每条序列均配有四个对齐版本：源数据、修复后的人体运动、直接机器人参考以及几何修复后的机器人参考。基于观测的局部人体运动修复、全身机器人几何修复以及跨表征溯源使得每次变换均可追踪。配对评估分别衡量人体运动的连续性与内容保持度、机器人参考的可行性以及物理执行效果。一种针对手语特征的运动学参考协议对完整规划运动中的手形、位置、手掌朝向及双手关系进行评分。全语料库结果显示，修复后异常手臂/手部步态减少，双手间及手与身体间的穿透现象也显著降低。控制实验将参考可学习性与课程效应分离，而分项评分则揭示了剩余的执行误差。

title: Safe Score Matching: Diffusion Policies with Hamilton-Jacobi Reachability for Online Safe Reinforcement Learning
summary: Online safe reinforcement learning (RL) seeks policies that maximize reward while satisfying safety constraints. A popular line of research in safe RL relaxes safety to a soft expected-cost constraint and solves the resulting Constrained Markov Decision Process via primal-dual Lagrangian updates that only enforce safety on average. To address this limitation, hard, state-wise constraints are introduced and often imposed through Hamilton-Jacobi (HJ) reachability. Yet such constraints require solving different objectives in the feasible and infeasible regions: reward maximization in the former, recovery toward the feasible regions in the latter. The resulting target action distributions are inherently multimodal, and this structure poses a fundamental challenge for the Gaussian or deterministic actors used in existing HJ-based safe RL, which often collapse onto suboptimal modes. Diffusion policies provide the expressiveness needed to represent such distributions, and recent work on Q-score matching offers a route to training them for online RL by score regression -- but has been applied only to reward maximization. We propose Safe Score Matching (SSM), an off-policy actor-critic method that adapts Q-score matching to hard-constrained safe RL by gating a two-branch score target with HJ reachability: inside the feasible set, the denoising process degenerates to Q-score matching on actions classified as viable by the HJ critic; outside, a recovery branch biases denoising toward regions with lower worst-case violation. On quadrotor and fixed-wing trajectory-tracking and stabilize-and-avoid benchmarks, SSM attains the best or near-best task performance with low false-safe rates, whereas the primal-dual baseline admits more unsafe behavior and reachability-based baselines tend to be more conservative; on Safety-Gymnasium velocity tasks, SSM attains the lowest cost with competitive reward.
tldr: This paper proposes Safe Score Matching (SSM), an off-policy actor-critic method that adapts Q-score matching to hard-constrained safe RL by using Hamilton-Jacobi reachability to gate a two-branch diffusion policy, achieving better or near-best task performance with low false-safe rates on quadrotor, fixed-wing, and Safety-Gymnasium benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出安全分数匹配（SSM），一种离策略演员-评论家方法，通过Hamilton-Jacobi可达性门控双分支扩散策略，将Q分数匹配适配到硬约束安全强化学习，在四旋翼、固定翼和Safety-Gymnasium基准上以低虚假安全率实现最优或接近最优的任务性能。
summary_zh: 在线安全强化学习（Safe RL）旨在在满足安全约束的同时最大化奖励的策略。安全强化学习中的一个主流研究方向是将安全约束放宽为软期望成本约束，并通过原始-对偶拉格朗日更新求解由此产生的约束马尔可夫决策过程，但这种方法仅在平均意义上保证安全。为解决此局限，引入了硬性、逐状态约束，并通常通过Hamilton-Jacobi（HJ）可达性分析来施加。然而，此类约束要求在可行区域和不可行区域中优化不同的目标：在可行区域中最大化奖励，在不可行区域中则向可行区域恢复。由此产生的目标动作分布本质上是多模态的，这种结构对现有基于HJ的安全强化学习中使用的高斯或确定性策略构成了根本性挑战，这些策略往往坍缩到次优模态上。扩散策略提供了表征此类分布所需的表达能力，而近期关于Q分数匹配的研究为通过分数回归训练在线强化学习中的扩散策略提供了一条途径——但该方法此前仅应用于奖励最大化。我们提出了安全分数匹配（Safe Score Matching, SSM），这是一种离策略演员-评论家方法，通过利用HJ可达性门控双分支分数目标，将Q分数匹配适配到硬约束安全强化学习：在可行集合内，去噪过程退化为对HJ评论家判定为可行的动作的Q分数匹配；在可行集合外，恢复分支将去噪过程偏向最坏情况违规更低的区域。在四旋翼和固定翼轨迹跟踪以及稳定-避障基准测试中，SSM以较低的误报安全率取得了最佳或接近最佳的任务性能，而原始-对偶基线允许更多不安全行为，基于可达性的基线则倾向于更保守；在Safety-Gymnasium速度任务中，SSM在获得有竞争力的奖励的同时实现了最低成本。

title: SocialHumanoid: Towards Expressive Humanoid Behavior via One-Step Co-Speech Motion Generation
summary: Humanoid robots are increasingly expected to serve as embodied social agents that communicate naturally with humans through face-to-face interaction. During such communication, humanoid robots require body behaviors that are synchronized with speech, affectively expressive, and suitable for real-time execution. However, existing co-speech methods are primarily developed for digital humans and lack joint support for affective control and low-latency continuous generation on physical embodiments. To bridge this gap, we present SocialHumanoid, a system for expressive humanoid behavior via one-step co-speech motion generation. Given response speech and a specified affective condition, SocialHumanoid generates each full-body motion window in a single forward pass and connects successive windows through motion-history conditioning. The generated human motion is further converted online into embodiment-compatible robot references and tracked by a whole-body controller for physical execution. To provide explicit supervision for affective body expression, we further introduce AffectMoCap, a 4-hour dataset captured from two professional actors, containing synchronized speech, body motion, fine-grained hand motion, and emotion annotations. On BEAT2, SocialHumanoid achieves the best FGD among the compared generation methods, competitive speech-motion synchrony, and approximately $6\times$ faster inference than GestureLSM under the same protocol. Perceptual evaluations further show that training with AffectMoCap improves affect recognition from generated body motion, while real-robot experiments demonstrate continuous affect-conditioned behavior and stable long-horizon execution. Our project page is https://rex0191.github.io/SocialHumanoid/.
tldr: This paper presents SocialHumanoid, a system for real-time, affectively expressive co-speech motion generation for humanoid robots, using one-step diffusion models and a novel AffectMoCap dataset, with real-robot experiments confirming stable execution.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了SocialHumanoid，一种用于人形机器人的实时、情感表达丰富的共语动作生成系统，采用单步扩散模型和新的AffectMoCap数据集，真实机器人实验验证了稳定执行。
summary_zh: 人形机器人日益被期望作为具身社交智能体，通过面对面的互动与人类自然交流。在此类交流过程中，人形机器人需要产生与语音同步、具有情感表现力且适合实时执行的身体行为。然而，现有的共语生成方法主要面向数字人开发，缺乏对物理实体上进行情感控制与低延迟连续生成的联合支持。为弥合这一差距，我们提出了SocialHumanoid——一种通过单步共语动作生成实现表达性人形行为的系统。给定响应语音和指定情感条件，SocialHumanoid在单次前向传播中生成每个全身动作窗口，并通过动作历史条件化连接连续窗口。生成的人体动作进一步在线转换为兼容机器人本体的参考动作，并由全身控制器跟踪以完成物理执行。为了对情感身体表达提供显式监督，我们进一步引入了AffectMoCap——一个从两位专业演员处采集的4小时数据集，包含同步语音、身体动作、细粒度手部动作及情感标注。在BEAT2上，SocialHumanoid在对比的生成方法中取得了最佳FGD，具有竞争力的语音-动作同步性，并且在相同协议下推理速度约为GestureLSM的6倍。感知评估进一步表明，使用AffectMoCap训练可提升从生成身体动作中进行情感识别的能力，而真实机器人实验则展示了连续情感条件化行为和稳定的长时程执行。我们的项目页面为 https://rex0191.github.io/SocialHumanoid/。

title: Informative Viewpoint Selection for Episodic-Memory Embodied Question Answering using Omnidirectional Images
summary: Embodied Question Answering (EQA) requires agents to answer natural language questions about surrounding environments from visual observations. In this work, we focus on open-vocabulary episodic-memory EQA (EM-EQA), where an agent answers free-form questions using recorded observation histories. Omnidirectional images are promising for this task, as they provide wide field-of-view observations that can capture surrounding context without requiring explicit camera rotations. However, omnidirectional images introduce two challenges for EQA: (i) equirectangular projection causes severe geometric distortion that degrades vision-language model (VLM) recognition accuracy, and (ii) feeding equirectangular images directly into VLMs introduces excessive irrelevant background information, reducing answer accuracy and increasing the visual-token burden. To address these challenges, we propose a viewpoint selection method for EM-EQA using omnidirectional images. Our method converts equirectangular observations into perspective views via cubemap projection, estimates question-conditioned relevance with fine-tuned BLIP-2, and selects informative and diverse viewpoints through diversity-aware greedy selection. Experiments on the Habitat-Matterport 3D (HM3D) subset of OpenEQA show that our method achieves state-of-the-art model performance among the reported model results with equirectangular observations. Moreover, after removing rotation views, which reduces observation frames by 65.5%, our method largely maintains its answer accuracy.
tldr: This paper proposes a viewpoint selection method for episodic-memory embodied question answering using omnidirectional images, converting equirectangular views to cubemap perspectives, estimating question-conditioned relevance with fine-tuned BLIP-2, and selecting diverse informative viewpoints to improve answer accuracy while reducing observation frames.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于使用全向图像进行情景记忆具身问答的视点选择方法，通过立方体贴图投影转换等距柱状视图，使用微调的 BLIP-2 估计基于问题的相关性，并选择信息丰富且多样化的视点，以提高答案准确性并减少观察帧。
summary_zh: 具身问答（EQA）要求智能体根据视觉观察回答关于周围环境的自然语言问题。在本工作中，我们聚焦于开放词汇的情景记忆具身问答（EM-EQA），即智能体利用记录的观察历史回答开放式问题。全方位图像在该任务中具有广阔前景，因为它们能提供宽视场角的观察，无需显式旋转相机即可捕获周围场景信息。然而，全方位图像给EQA带来了两个挑战：（i）等距柱状投影会导致严重的几何畸变，降低视觉-语言模型（VLM）的识别精度；（ii）将等距柱状图像直接输入VLM会引入过多无关的背景信息，降低答案准确性并增加视觉令牌负担。为解决这些挑战，我们提出了一种针对使用全方位图像的EM-EQA的视点选择方法。该方法通过立方体投影将等距柱状观察转换为透视视图，利用微调后的BLIP-2估计与问题相关的相关性，并通过多样性感知的贪心选择挑选信息丰富且多样化的视点。在OpenEQA的Habitat-Matterport 3D（HM3D）子集上的实验表明，在已报告的等距柱状观察模型结果中，我们的方法达到了最先进的模型性能。此外，在去除旋转视图后（观察帧减少65.5%），我们的方法仍能大体保持其答案准确性。

title: When an Evaluation Rule Writes Training Labels: Measuring Human-Reference Forgiveness in NAVSIM
summary: When the human reference scores zero on a metric, the released GTRS-Dense label generator for NAVSIM marks every candidate trajectory in the scene as passing it. NAVSIM's authors introduced this human-reference forgiveness to avoid penalizing contextually justified maneuvers when scoring one trajectory, and warned that it could overlook important failures. In label generation it sets a whole column of 16,384 candidate targets to passing. To measure the consequences for supervision, we re-run the generator with the overwrite disabled and compare the pre-overwrite targets with the released labels on all 103,288 navtrain scenes. The rule erases a candidate distinction that the training loss reads on 11,237 of them (10.8793%). Firing usually changes most of a column: lane keeping carries 9,982 of the 13,042 forgiven loss columns, and its median forgiven column had 14,391 of 16,384 candidates failing before the overwrite. On held-out navtest scenes forgiven on lane keeping, the released lane-keeping head's median AUC against the pre-overwrite outcome is 0.7095; on unforgiven scenes matched on failing-candidate count it is 0.9807. For the Hydra-MDP checkpoint released with GTRS, whose configuration takes the same label file, the two values are 0.6627 and 0.9761. Continuing the released GTRS-Dense checkpoint for 300 optimizer steps with three paired seeds, we observe the forgiven-scene AUC 0.1086-0.1251 higher with pre-overwrite than with published targets, and a narrower gap between matched groups, still above zero. Scoring with forgiveness disabled, we observe lane keeping higher by 2.478-3.524 points on navtest scenes forgiven on any of five loss metrics, with lower adjacent-frame plan consistency. Both changes are larger there than on the rest. EPDMS, scored the same way, does not separate the two target sets.
tldr: This paper analyzes the impact of a human-reference forgiveness rule in the NAVSIM driving simulator's label generator on training of driving models, showing it erases distinctions in training targets and reduces lane-keeping performance.
tldr_zh: 本文分析了NAVSIM驾驶模拟器中人类参考宽恕规则对驾驶模型训练的影响，表明该规则消除了训练目标中的区分，降低了车道保持性能。
summary_zh: 当人类参考分数在某一指标上为零时，发布的NAVSIM GTRS-Dense标签生成器会将场景中所有候选轨迹标记为通过。NAVSIM的作者引入了这种人类参考豁免机制，以避免在评分单条轨迹时惩罚情境合理的操作，同时警告这可能忽略重要失败。在标签生成过程中，该机制将一整列共16，384个候选目标全部设为通过。为衡量这种监督方式带来的影响，我们禁用了覆盖写入功能重新运行生成器，并在全部103，288个navtrain场景中比较覆盖写入前的目标与发布的标签。该规则消除了训练损失在11，237个场景（占10.8793%）中所读取的候选区分信息。触发时通常会改变列中的大部分内容：车道保持占据了13，042个被豁免损失列中的9，982个，且其被豁免列的中位数在覆盖写入前有14，391个（共16，384个）候选目标为失败。在保留的车道保持被豁免的navtest场景中，发布的lane-keeping head相对于覆盖写入前结果的中位AUC为0.7095；在按失败候选数量匹配的未豁免场景中，该值为0.9807。对于随GTRS发布的Hydra-MDP检查点（其配置使用相同的标签文件），这两个值分别为0.6627和0.9761。使用三对随机种子对发布的GTRS-Dense检查点继续训练300个优化步骤，我们观察到在豁免场景中，使用覆盖写入前目标的AUC比使用已发布目标高0.1086至0.1251，且匹配组之间的差距缩小但仍大于零。在禁用豁免机制的评分方式下，我们观察到在五个损失指标中任一指标被豁免的navtest场景上，车道保持得分高出2.478至3.524点，同时相邻帧规划一致性较低。这两项变化在被豁免场景上的幅度均大于其余场景。以相同方式评分的EPDMS无法区分这两组目标集。

title: Beyond State-as-Action: Exploiting Command-State Discrepancy for Robot Imitation Learning
summary: Constructing action targets from measured robot motion is an established approach in imitation learning. Under interaction constraints, however, command-state discrepancy may reflect control demands that motion alone does not capture. We investigate when this information matters and how to exploit it. Across three real-robot tasks, task and phase analyses reveal larger supervision gaps under constrained interaction, while selective command retention provides evidence of locally useful command information. Building on these findings, we propose Command-State Discrepancy Weighting (CSDW), which accounts for robot response times and combines subsequent progress, persistent unmet demand, and demand changes into continuous weights for command supervision. The method requires no task-phase annotations or changes to policy architecture or inference. CSDW improves over uniform command supervision on constrained tasks, while methods perform similarly in the less constrained task.
tldr: This paper investigates command-state discrepancy in robot imitation learning, proposing Command-State Discrepancy Weighting (CSDW) to selectively supervise commands based on robot response times and unmet demand, improving performance on constrained real-robot tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了机器人模仿学习中的指令-状态差异，提出了指令-状态差异加权（CSDW），根据机器人响应时间和未满足的需求选择性监督指令，在受约束的真实机器人任务上提升了性能。
summary_zh: 从测量的机器人运动构建动作目标是模仿学习中的一种成熟方法。然而，在交互约束下，指令-状态差异可能反映出仅凭运动无法捕捉的控制需求。我们研究了这些信息何时重要以及如何加以利用。在三个真实机器人任务中，任务与阶段分析表明，在约束交互下监督差距更大，而选择性指令保留则提供了局部指令信息有用的证据。基于这些发现，我们提出了指令-状态差异加权方法（CSDW），该方法考虑机器人响应时间，并将后续进展、持续未满足的需求及需求变化整合为指令监督的连续权重。该方法无需任务阶段标注，也无需改变策略架构或推理方式。在约束任务中，CSDW相比统一指令监督表现更优，而在约束较少的任务中，各方法表现相近。

title: Multi-Modal Non-Prehensile Estimation of Physical Parameters via Press-and-Pull Tipping
summary: Recovering physical properties of unknown objects through non-prehensile interaction is challenging because no single manipulation primitive reveals all relevant parameters. Planar pushing couples mass and friction, while conventional tipping cannot recover friction and may fail entirely when low-friction or curved-base objects slide or rotate instead of tipping. We introduce a multi-modal estimation framework that combines a sliding interaction with a press-and-pull tipping primitive to recover object mass, center of mass height, and surface friction. The press-and-pull interaction increases the object-table sliding threshold and stabilizes the pivot, enabling controlled tipping without any prior geometric object model. Wrist force/torque sensing, RGB-D perception, and robot proprioception are fused to estimate the physical parameters from the two complementary interaction modes. Experiments on an ABB IRB120 across four objects with varied geometry, mass, center of mass, and friction achieve low relative error, while successfully operating on curved-base objects that fail under conventional forward tipping. The results demonstrate that complementary non-prehensile interactions can recover a compact set of physical parameters without grasping, a prior object model, or learned interaction dynamics.
tldr: This paper introduces a multi-modal estimation framework combining sliding and press-and-pull tipping interactions to recover object mass, center of mass height, and surface friction without grasping or prior object models, validated on a real robot.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种多模态估计框架，结合滑动和按压-拉动倾倒交互来恢复物体质量、质心高度和表面摩擦系数，无需抓取或先验物体模型，并在真实机器人上验证。
summary_zh: 通过非抓取交互恢复未知物体的物理属性具有挑战性，因为单一的操纵基元无法揭示所有相关参数。平面推挤将质量与摩擦耦合在一起，而传统的倾倒方法无法恢复摩擦参数，且对于低摩擦或曲面底座的物体，当其发生滑动或旋转而非倾倒时，该方法可能完全失效。我们提出了一种多模态估计框架，将滑动交互与按压-拉动倾倒基元相结合，以恢复物体的质量、质心高度和表面摩擦系数。按压-拉动交互提高了物体与桌面之间的滑动阈值，并稳定了支点，从而在无需任何先验几何物体模型的情况下实现可控倾倒。腕部力/力矩传感、RGB-D感知和机器人本体感觉被融合在一起，从两种互补的交互模式中估计物理参数。在ABB IRB120上对四种具有不同几何形状、质量、质心位置和摩擦系数的物体进行的实验取得了较低的相对误差，同时成功处理了在传统正向倾倒下失效的曲面底座物体。结果表明，互补的非抓取交互可以在无需抓取、先验物体模型或学习交互动力学的情况下，恢复一组紧凑的物理参数。

title: Evolving Dexterous Robots from Scratch
summary: Little is known about how to manually design agents capable of dexterous manipulation. Some design principles have been inferred from close examination of how animals manipulate objects, but these structures and behaviors have so far resisted biomimicry and may not be optimal for artificial machines. Here we evolve freeform robots to pick up, hold, rotate, and use diverse objects. Unlike other approaches to optimizing robot hands, we do not presuppose the presence, articulation, or geometry of any part of the body. Although familiar prehensile forms such as tails, beaks, paws and claws may emerge spontaneously under certain conditions--and while such conditions could be of interest to evolutionary biologists--de novo manipulator design can also reveal whole new solutions, overlooked or unknown structures which may be better suited for the task at hand. We use contrastive learning to create a highly searchable genetic embedding of design space, an autoregressive developmental model to decode designs, evolutionary strategies to find good designs, and reinforcement learning to train each evolved design. Winning designs were automatically converted into a manufacturable blueprint, printed, assembled and tested in the real world in a zero-shot manner. The results represent the state-of-the-art in evolutionary robotics in terms of performance, diversity and complexity.
tldr: This paper evolves freeform robot morphologies from scratch for dexterous manipulation tasks using contrastive learning, an autoregressive developmental model, evolutionary strategies, and reinforcement learning, with zero-shot transfer to real-world printed robots.
tldr_zh: 本文从头进化自由形态机器人形态以完成灵巧操作任务，结合对比学习、自回归发育模型、进化策略和强化学习，并零样本转移到真实打印机器人。
summary_zh: 关于如何手动设计能够进行灵巧操作的智能体，目前所知甚少。通过细致观察动物如何操控物体，人们推断出了一些设计原则，但迄今为止，这些结构与行为模式抗拒着仿生学的模仿，并且对于人造机器而言可能并非最优。在此，我们进化出自由形态机器人，使其能够拾取、握持、旋转并利用多种物体。与其他优化机器人手部的方法不同，我们并不预设身体任何部分的存在、关节连接方式或几何形状。尽管在某些条件下，诸如尾巴、喙、爪子和钳子等熟悉的抓取形态可能会自发涌现——虽然此类条件或许会引起进化生物学家的兴趣——但从头开始的操纵器设计也能揭示全新的解决方案，即那些可能更适合当前任务的被忽视或未知的结构。我们利用对比学习创建了一个高度可搜索的遗传嵌入设计空间，采用自回归发育模型来解码设计，运用进化策略来寻找优秀设计，并通过强化学习来训练每一个进化出的设计。获胜的设计被自动转换成可制造的蓝图，以零样本方式打印、组装并在现实世界中进行测试。在性能、多样性和复杂性方面，这些结果代表了进化机器人技术的当前最高水平。

title: Query, Align, and Distill: Navigation-Aware Cross-Modal Interaction for Efficient Vision-and-Language Navigation
summary: Recent large-scale Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) models deliver strong accuracy but remain costly to deploy due to their large parameter counts and computational requirements. We tackle efficient VLN in two steps. First, we build a high-performing teacher that makes navigation evidence selection explicit and compressible. The teacher introduces a small set of learnable query slots to extract global and local action-sufficient navigable evidence from panoramic observations via a Navigable Query Generator, then progressively grounds these evidence tokens to the instruction with an Instruction-Query Aligner for policy prediction. Second, using this explicit query bottleneck as a distillation interface, we train a compact student by transferring both where to attend and what to do. We distill the teacher's global and local navigable queries with a navigation-aware token-adaptive objective, then further match action distributions during fine-tuning. Experiments on standard VLN benchmarks demonstrate that our student nearly matches the teacher's navigation performance while reducing the number of parameters by 93.65% compared to the teacher.
tldr: This paper introduces a navigation-aware cross-modal interaction framework that uses learnable query slots as a distillation interface, enabling a compact student model to nearly match a large teacher model's VLN performance with 93.65% fewer parameters.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种导航感知的跨模态交互框架，利用可学习查询槽作为蒸馏接口，使紧凑的学生模型在参数减少93.65%的情况下，几乎匹配大教师模型的视觉语言导航性能。
summary_zh: 近期的大规模视觉与语言导航（VLN）模型虽然实现了较高的准确率，但由于其参数量庞大、计算需求高，部署成本依然高昂。我们分两步来解决高效VLN问题。首先，我们构建了一个高性能的教师模型，使导航证据的选择变得明确且可压缩。该教师模型引入一组少量的可学习查询槽，通过可导航查询生成器从全景观测中提取全局和局部、足以支持动作的导航证据，然后通过指令-查询对齐器逐步将这些证据标记与指令进行对齐，以进行策略预测。其次，我们利用这一显式的查询瓶颈作为蒸馏接口，通过传递“关注何处”和“执行何事”来训练一个紧凑的学生模型。我们使用一种导航感知的令牌自适应目标函数，对教师模型的全局和局部可导航查询进行蒸馏，并在微调阶段进一步匹配动作分布。在标准VLN基准上的实验表明，我们的学生模型在导航性能上几乎与教师模型持平，同时参数量较教师模型减少了93.65%。

title: Humanoids for Robot-Assisted Surgery: Bimanual Base Placement and Tool-Mount Optimization via Capability Maps
summary: Rapid advances in humanoid robotics have motivated growing interest in the application of humanoids for healthcare and clinical tasks. However, it remains unclear how close contemporary humanoids are to meeting the kinematic demands of robot-assisted laparoscopic surgery. In this work, we address the question of optimal robot positioning through a quantitative analysis of workspace and robot setup configurations. We present a capability-map-based robot setup framework that optimizes humanoid base placement and tool mounting orientation to maximize bimanual humanoid reachability while accounting for tool-tip kinematics and remote-center-of-motion (RCM) constraints. We evaluate three humanoid platforms spanning different body dimensions and kinematic redundancy on workspace reachability for three representative general surgery procedures: cholecystectomy, inguinal hernia repair, and sleeve gastrectomy. The proposed joint optimization of base placement and tool mounting consistently outperforms base-only optimization and heuristic baselines. For cholecystectomy and inguinal hernia repair, which are characterized by relatively small and minimally overlapping workspaces, humanoid reachability approached 90%. For the larger, overlapping multi-port arm workspace of sleeve gastrectomy, humanoids yield substantially lower coverage. These results quantify the near-term promise of humanoids for selected laparoscopic procedures and clarify key limitations that must be addressed for broader deployment.
tldr: This paper proposes a capability-map-based framework for optimizing humanoid robot base placement and tool mounting orientation to maximize bimanual reachability for robot-assisted laparoscopic surgery, evaluated on three humanoid platforms across three surgical procedures.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于能力图的人形机器人基座放置和工具安装方向优化框架，以最大化双臂在机器人辅助腹腔镜手术中的可达性，并在三个人形平台和三种手术流程上进行了评估。
summary_zh: 人形机器人技术的快速发展激发了人们对其在医疗保健和临床任务中应用日益浓厚的兴趣。然而，当代人形机器人在多大程度上能够满足机器人辅助腹腔镜手术的运动学需求，目前仍不清楚。在本研究中，我们通过工作空间和机器人设置配置的定量分析，探讨了最优机器人定位问题。我们提出了一种基于能力图谱的机器人设置框架，该框架优化了人形机器人基座位置和工具安装方向，以最大化双臂人形机器人的可达性，同时考虑工具末端运动学和远端运动中心约束。我们评估了三款具有不同体型尺寸和运动学冗余度的人形机器人平台，针对三种代表性普外科手术——胆囊切除术、腹股沟疝修补术和袖状胃切除术——的工作空间可达性进行了评价。所提出的基座位置与工具安装联合优化方法在性能上始终优于仅优化基座的方法和启发式基线方法。对于工作空间相对较小且重叠区域极少的胆囊切除术和腹股沟疝修补术，人形机器人的可达性接近90%。而对于工作空间较大且多孔臂工作区重叠的袖状胃切除术，人形机器人的覆盖率则显著较低。这些结果量化了人形机器人在特定腹腔镜手术中的近期应用前景，并明确了其更广泛部署所需解决的关键局限性。

title: SwingRL: Adaptive Observation Reinforcement Learning with World-Model Prediction for Cable-Suspended Hoisting Control
summary: Cable-suspended hoisting is widely used to move heavy or bulky payloads that cannot be handled conveniently by rigid pick-and-place systems, for example in crane-assisted construction. Robotic hoisting using flexible cables is challenging because payload motion is underactuated, external disturbances vary, and delayed or lost visual observations can make the perceived payload state stale at control execution. These effects are particularly critical during precise insertion of a suspended payload's sockets onto rebar pins, which is a very common task in construction environments. We present SwingRL, a residual reinforcement-learning (RL) framework that combines an age-aware world model, a classical anti-swing prior, and a recurrent residual policy to address two coupled problems: stale feedback and uncertain dynamics. The world model propagates the newest received payload observation to the current control step using the executed commands, providing a time-aligned state estimate under delayed and lossy sensing. The prior supplies nominal tracking and swing damping. The residual policy learns bounded corrections to the prior rather than the complete control law, compensating for system-parameter variation, external disturbances, and remaining state-estimation errors. We evaluate SwingRL against classical and learning-based baselines across a cumulative difficulty ladder covering system-parameter variation, wind disturbance, degraded sensing, and strong gusts. Under the most difficult setting, SwingRL achieves 69.5% strict and 77.3% broad success, exceeding all baselines by at least 60 percentage points, respectively. World-model ablations support the role of time-aligned state estimation in maintaining insertion success as observation loss increases. Finally, without real-robot fine-tuning, SwingRL achieves 90% success on the physical rig.
tldr: SwingRL introduces a residual reinforcement learning framework with an age-aware world model and anti-swing prior to handle delayed/lost observations and uncertain dynamics for cable-suspended hoisting, achieving high success in simulation and on a physical rig.
tldr_zh: SwingRL提出了一种结合年龄感知世界模型和防摆动先验的残差强化学习框架，以应对缆索悬吊作业中的观测延迟/丢失和动态不确定性问题，在仿真和物理平台上均取得了高成功率。
summary_zh: 缆索悬挂提升广泛应用于搬运重型或大型载荷的场景，这些载荷难以由刚性拾放系统便捷处理，例如在起重机辅助施工中。使用柔性缆索进行机器人提升具有挑战性，因为载荷运动欠驱动、外部扰动多变，且延迟或丢失的视觉观测可能导致控制执行时所感知的载荷状态过时。这些效应在将悬挂载荷的套筒精确插入钢筋销钉的过程中尤为关键，而这是施工环境中非常常见的任务。我们提出了SwingRL，一种残差强化学习框架，结合了考虑时延的世界模型、经典防摆先验和循环残差策略，以解决两个耦合问题：反馈过时和动力学不确定性。世界模型利用已执行命令将最新接收到的载荷观测传播至当前控制步，从而在延迟和有损感知条件下提供时间对齐的状态估计。先验提供标称跟踪和摆动阻尼。残差策略学习对先验的有界修正，而非完整控制律，从而补偿系统参数变化、外部扰动以及剩余的状态估计误差。我们将SwingRL与经典基线和基于学习的基线进行对比评估，覆盖包含系统参数变化、风扰动、感知退化及强阵风的累积难度阶梯。在最困难设置下，SwingRL实现了69.5%的严格成功率和77.3%的宽泛成功率，分别超过所有基线至少60个百分点。世界模型消融实验验证了时间对齐状态估计在观测丢失增加时维持插入成功中的作用。最后，无需真实机器人微调，SwingRL在物理实验平台上实现了90%的成功率。

title: Is Online Interaction Necessary for Recovery? A Minimalist Approach to Robust Planning via Perturbation
summary: Behavior cloning (BC) is vulnerable to covariate shift during closed-loop execution, where small prediction or execution errors can drive the robot toward states poorly covered by the demonstration data. We focus on action-sequence planning, where a policy predicts a finite-horizon sequence of actions as a reference trajectory for robot execution. Existing approaches to covariate shift often rely on collecting additional corrective demonstrations, requiring further environment interaction and access to an expert or reference policy. We propose Perturbation-Augmented Recovery Supervision (PARS), a simple training approach for improving recovery using only existing demonstrations. PARS perturbs the robot's proprioceptive state and anchors only the later portion of the predicted trajectory to the original demonstration, leaving the earlier portion free to generate corrective motion and recover toward the demonstrated behavior within the planning horizon. Unlike conventional input-noise augmentation, which preserves the original supervision target over the entire prediction horizon, PARS explicitly provides trajectory-level supervision for recovery from perturbed states. PARS requires neither additional environment interaction nor expert queries and can be instantiated across different action-sequence policy classes with only minor modifications to their BC objectives. Experiments on 51 RLBench manipulation tasks with flow-based, transformer-based, and diffusion-based policies demonstrate that PARS improves robustness to covariate shift during closed-loop execution.
tldr: This paper proposes Perturbation-Augmented Recovery Supervision (PARS), a training-only method that improves robustness to covariate shift in action-sequence planning policies by perturbing proprioceptive states and anchoring the later portion of predicted trajectories to demonstrations, requiring no additional environment interaction or expert queries. It is validated across flow-based, transformer-based, and diffusion-based policies on 51 RLBench manipulation tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种名为PARS的训练方法，通过扰动本体感觉状态并将预测轨迹的后半部分锚定到原始演示，在不额外交互环境或查询专家的情况下，提高动作序列规划策略对协变量偏移的鲁棒性，并在51个RLBench操作任务和多种策略上得到验证。
summary_zh: 行为克隆（BC）在闭环执行过程中容易受到协变量偏移的影响，此时微小的预测或执行误差可能将机器人推向演示数据覆盖不足的状态。本文聚焦于动作序列规划，即策略预测有限时域内的动作序列作为机器人执行的参考轨迹。现有应对协变量偏移的方法往往依赖收集额外的纠正性演示，这需要进一步的环境交互以及专家或参考策略的介入。我们提出扰动增强恢复监督（PARS），一种仅利用现有演示即可改善恢复能力的简洁训练方法。PARS对机器人的本体感觉状态施加扰动，并仅将预测轨迹的后段锚定至原始演示，前段则自由生成纠正动作，从而在规划时域内恢复至演示行为。与传统的输入噪声增强方法（后者在整个预测时域内保持原始监督目标不变）不同，PARS明确针对扰动状态提供轨迹层面的恢复监督。PARS无需额外的环境交互，也无需专家查询，只需对行为克隆目标进行少量修改，即可适用于不同类别的动作序列策略。在51项RLBench操作任务上，基于流、基于变换器及基于扩散的策略实验表明，PARS能够提升闭环执行过程中对协变量偏移的鲁棒性。

title: Learning Geometry-Aware Virtual Fixtures From Sparse Demonstrations
summary: In many teleoperation applications, collecting a large number of demonstrations as required for traditional probabilistic learning from demonstration (LfD) approaches may not be feasible. To still give operators the ability to intuitively create trajectories as Virtual Fixtures (VFs), we propose to leverage a motion prior in the learning process. Particularly, by using Linear Quadratic Tracking (LQT), users are able to define guiding trajectories from the demonstration of just a few via points. To account for orientation guidance, we further reformulate classical LQT on Riemannian manifolds, introducing an additional geometric prior. Through a probabilistic interpretation of the LQT solution, we derive a covariance estimate at each trajectory point which we use to modulate the stiffness of the resulting fixture, resulting in strong guidance around the via points and softer guidance when far away. The covariance information is also used to define a validity region of the fixture, allowing the operator to leave its influence area and conduct unmodeled tasks. We evaluate the proposed Riemannian LQT formulation in a set of toy examples and the full framework on a cutting task requiring high precision in a minimally invasive surgery setting on the da Vinci Research Kit (dVRK).
tldr: This paper proposes a learning-from-demonstration framework that uses Linear Quadratic Tracking with a Riemannian manifold formulation to create virtual fixtures from sparse demonstrations, with covariance-based stiffness modulation for teleoperation guidance, evaluated on a dVRK surgical robot.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种基于黎曼流形上线性二次跟踪的从稀疏演示学习虚拟夹具框架，通过协方差调制刚度，并在达芬奇手术机器人上验证。
summary_zh: 在许多遥操作应用中，收集大量示范数据以支持传统的基于示范的概率学习（LfD）方法可能并不可行。为使操作者仍能直观地创建作为虚拟夹具（VFs）的轨迹，我们提出在学习过程中利用运动先验。具体而言，通过采用线性二次跟踪（LQT），用户只需示范少量路径点即可定义引导轨迹。为考虑姿态引导，我们进一步在黎曼流形上重新表述经典LQT，引入额外的几何先验。通过对LQT解的概率解释，我们在每个轨迹点处推导出协方差估计，并利用该估计调节所生成夹具的刚度，从而在路径点附近提供强引导，而在远离路径点时提供较柔和的引导。协方差信息还用于定义夹具的有效区域，使操作者能够离开其影响范围以执行未建模的任务。我们在若干玩具示例中评估了所提出的黎曼LQT公式，并在达芬奇研究套件（dVRK）上针对微创手术场景中需要高精度的切割任务评估了完整框架。

title: FINE: Future-Informed Navigation Encoding for Data-Efficient Vision-Language Navigation
summary: Adapting vision-language navigation (VLN) policies to new environments is expensive because every additional route and instruction requires an embodied demonstration. Yet standard observation-to-action training uses only a small fraction of the information already contained in each trajectory. In particular, future observations reveal the instruction-relevant landmarks that the agent will encounter, including what they look like and how they are arranged in 3D. We introduce FINE, a Future-Informed Navigation Encoding framework that extracts this latent supervision from existing demonstrations. FINE equips a VLN backbone with two complementary auxiliary representations. First, explicit landmark tokens follow the ordered landmarks specified by the instruction and are trained to predict future landmark regions in both semantic 2D patch-feature space and viewpoint-dependent 3D geometric feature space. Second, an implicit future token learns to distinguish the landmark state that is actually reached from plausible same-scene counterfactual futures generated by a video world model. On R2R-CE and RxR-CE val-unseen, FINE improves InternVLA-N1 by 2.6 and 4.5 success-rate points, respectively, at full training data. More importantly, as demonstrations become limited, the benefit grows: at a 70% demonstration budget, FINE improves success rate by 6.8 points, recovering roughly one-third of the performance lost by reducing the training demonstrations. Project page is available at https://finevln.github.io/.
tldr: FINE proposes a future-informed navigation encoding framework that extracts latent supervision from existing VLN demonstrations, using explicit landmark tokens and an implicit future token trained with a video world model to improve data efficiency and success rate on R2R-CE and RxR-CE benchmarks.
tldr_zh: FINE提出了一种面向未来信息的导航编码框架，从现有VLN演示中提取潜在监督，利用显式地标令牌和由视频世界模型训练的隐式未来令牌，在R2R-CE和RxR-CE基准上提高了数据效率和成功率。
summary_zh: 将视觉语言导航（VLN）策略适应到新环境成本高昂，因为每条新增路径和指令都需要具身演示。然而，标准的观测到动作训练仅利用了每条轨迹中已包含信息的一小部分。特别是，未来观测揭示了智能体将遇到的与指令相关的地标，包括它们的外观及在三维空间中的排列方式。我们提出了FINE（未来信息导航编码框架），该框架从现有演示中提取这种潜在监督信息。FINE为VLN主干网络配备两种互补的辅助表示。第一种是显式地标标记，它们遵循指令指定的有序地标，并被训练用于在语义二维补丁特征空间和依赖于视点的三维几何特征空间中预测未来地标区域。第二种是隐式未来标记，它学习区分实际到达的地标状态与由视频世界模型生成的合理同场景反事实未来。在R2R-CE和RxR-CE的val-unseen数据集上，使用全部训练数据时，FINE使InternVLA-N1的成功率分别提升了2.6和4.5个百分点。更重要的是，当演示数据有限时，其收益更加显著：在70%演示数据预算下，FINE将成功率提升了6.8个百分点，恢复了因减少训练演示而损失性能的大约三分之一。项目页面可访问 https://finevln.github.io/。

title: Resolving State-Representation Mismatch: State-Space Visual Reasoning for Open-Loop VLA Planning
summary: Despite rapid progress in vision-language-action (VLA) models, existing reasoning paradigms still face a fundamental \emph{state-representation mismatch} in open-loop planning. Given only an initial observation, models must internally simulate action-conditioned state transitions, whereas text-, pixel-, and latent-space reasoning can suffer from lossy spatial compression, error-accumulating visual generation, and bypass of intermediate latent tokens, respectively, undermining reliable long-horizon planning. We propose \textbf{State-Space Visual Reasoning} (SSVR), which decouples static visual context, language constraints, and a recurrent latent state. SSVR encodes the initial image and instruction once, then conditions each action prediction on the latent state and updates it with an action-conditioned GRU. Using Qwen2.5-VL as the backbone, SSVR achieves 99.5/99.6, 96.3/98.0, and 83.9/90.6 EM/PR on FrozenLake, Maze, and MiniBehavior, substantially outperforming prior methods. Extensive experiments support the effectiveness of recurrent state modeling for VLA open-loop planning across input transformations and transfer settings. By reusing static visual-textual context and updating a compact recurrent state, SSVR supports efficient multi-step inference, achieving up to $98.58\times$ faster Maze decoding rollouts than the evaluated baselines with the prefix cache prebuilt.
tldr: SSVR introduces a recurrent latent state to decouple static visual context and language constraints in VLA open-loop planning, improving long-horizon reasoning and inference efficiency.
tldr_zh: SSVR 通过循环潜状态解耦静态视觉上下文和语言约束，提升了 VLA 开环规划中的长时程推理能力和推理效率。
summary_zh: 尽管视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型取得了快速进展，现有的推理范式在开环规划中仍面临一个根本性的\emph{状态表示不匹配}问题。在仅给定初始观察的情况下，模型必须在内部模拟基于动作的条件状态转换，而文本空间、像素空间和潜在空间推理分别可能遭受有损空间压缩、误差累积的视觉生成以及中间潜在令牌被跳过等问题，从而削弱了可靠的长期规划能力。我们提出了\textbf{状态空间视觉推理}（SSVR），该方法将静态视觉上下文、语言约束和循环潜在状态解耦。SSVR 对初始图像和指令仅编码一次，然后基于潜在状态对每个动作预测进行条件化，并通过基于动作的门控循环单元（GRU）更新该状态。以 Qwen2.5-VL 作为骨干模型，SSVR 在 FrozenLake、Maze 和 MiniBehavior 上分别达到了 99.5/99.6、96.3/98.0 和 83.9/90.6 的 EM/PR 指标，显著优于现有方法。大量实验证明了循环状态建模在 VLA 开环规划中的有效性，涵盖了不同输入变换和迁移设置。通过复用静态视觉-文本上下文并更新紧凑的循环状态，SSVR 支持高效的多步推理，在预构建前缀缓存的情况下，其 Maze 解码速度相比评估的基线方法最高提升达 $98.58\times$。

title: Beyond Conservatism: Recoverability-Conditioned Exploration for Model-Based Imitation Learning
summary: Model-based imitation learning (MBIL) improves real-environment interaction efficiency by optimizing policies on imagined rollouts from a learned world model. However, the gap between model-induced and real-environment occupancies makes policy learning sensitive to model error. Conservative MBIL mitigates model exploitation during policy optimization, but when real-environment interactions are collected by the same conservative policy, uncertain regions around the expert distribution remain insufficiently sampled. Generic uncertainty-driven exploration, on the other hand, may allocate interaction to novel but task-irrelevant dynamics. We propose REcoverability-CONditioned Exploration for Model-Based Imitation Learning (RECON). RECON separates conservative policy learning from active data collection by maintaining a main policy for task execution and an explorer for real-environment interaction. The explorer is optimized based on epistemic uncertainty conditioned on recoverability estimated from multi-step main-policy imagination, focusing data collection on unknown states from which the main policy can still return toward expert behavior. Experiments on locomotion, navigation and manipulation show consistent gains in interaction efficiency, imitation performance, and robustness, indicating that RECON directs real-environment interaction toward recovery regions around the expert distribution that are underexplored by prior methods, and thereby learns a world model better suited for imitation.
tldr: RECON proposes a recoverability-conditioned exploration strategy for model-based imitation learning, separating conservative policy learning from active data collection to focus real-environment interaction on recoverable states, improving efficiency and robustness across locomotion, navigation, and manipulation.
tldr_zh: RECON 提出了一种基于可恢复性条件的探索策略，用于基于模型的模仿学习，将保守策略学习与实际数据收集分离，聚焦于可恢复状态，提升交互效率和鲁棒性。
summary_zh: 基于模型的模仿学习通过优化在习得的世界模型上生成的想象轨迹，提升了在真实环境中的交互效率。然而，模型诱导的占用度量与真实环境占用度量之间的差异，使得策略学习对模型误差十分敏感。保守式基于模型的模仿学习在策略优化过程中缓解了模型利用问题，但当真实环境交互由同一保守策略收集时，专家分布周围的不确定区域仍难以得到充分采样。另一方面，通用的不确定性驱动探索可能将交互资源分配给新颖但与任务无关的动力学区域。我们提出了基于可恢复性条件的探索方法，用于基于模型的模仿学习（RECON）。RECON将保守策略学习与主动数据收集分离，维护一个用于任务执行的主策略和一个用于真实环境交互的探索器。探索器基于认知不确定性进行优化，该不确定性以从多步主策略想象中估计的可恢复性为条件，从而将数据收集聚焦于主策略仍能回归专家行为轨迹的未知状态。在运动控制、导航和操作任务上的实验表明，RECON在交互效率、模仿性能和鲁棒性方面均取得了一致提升，说明该方法能将真实环境交互引导至专家分布周围先前方法未充分探索的可恢复区域，从而习得更适合模仿学习的世

title: Does Learning to Predict the World Help Agents Act? Auditing World-Model Post-Training
summary: Predicting how an environment will change before acting is a natural route to better decision making for agents. Recent post-training methods therefore require agents to predict the next observation and turn that prediction into a reward or a direct supervision signal, which is called world model. Existing next-observation training methods help the agent to learn the environmental content. However, they additionally involve an optimization process, which may introduce several effects other than learning to predict the world. Consequently, where the performance gain comes from during the training process remains an open question. We answer this research question through replacing true next-observation targets with in-distribution mismatched observations during the training process. Across two interactive text environments, mismatched targets lower prediction accuracy by 15.3-61.6% relative to ground-truth targets, yet retain substantial task gains over the base model. Compared with the base model, trained models consider more candidate actions and exhibit less looping. We also introduce a setting that replaces prediction-based rewards with independent random signals. This training expands task coverage (pass@64) even when the reward carries no environment information. We also generalize this finding to VisualWebArena, where random-reward training raises pass@64 by 14.3% relative to the base model, without observation-matching rewards or an external multimodal teacher for reward construction.
tldr: This paper audits world-model post-training by replacing true next-observation targets with mismatched or random targets, finding that substantial task improvements persist even without accurate world predictions, suggesting gains may stem from optimization side-effects rather than world modeling.
tldr_zh: 本文通过用不匹配或随机目标替换真实下一观测目标来审计世界模型后训练，发现即使没有准确的世界预测，任务性能仍有显著提升，表明收益可能来自优化副作用而非世界建模。
summary_zh: 预测环境在行动之前将如何变化，是智能体做出更好决策的自然途径。因此，近年来的后训练方法要求智能体预测下一个观察，并将该预测转化为奖励或直接监督信号，这一机制被称为世界模型。现有的下一观察训练方法帮助智能体学习环境内容。然而，这些方法还涉及一个优化过程，该过程可能引入除学习预测世界之外的多种效应。因此，训练过程中性能提升的来源仍是一个悬而未决的问题。我们通过在训练过程中用分布内不匹配的观察替换真实的下一个观察目标来回答这一研究问题。在两个交互式文本环境中，不匹配目标相对于真实目标将预测准确率降低了15.3%至61.6%，但仍保留了相对于基础模型的显著任务收益。与基础模型相比，训练后的模型会考虑更多候选动作，并表现出更少的循环行为。我们还引入了一种用独立随机信号替换基于预测的奖励的设置。即使奖励不携带环境信息，这种训练也能扩展任务覆盖率（pass@64）。我们还将这一发现推广到VisualWebArena，其中随机奖励训练相对于基础模型将pass@64提高了14.3%，且无需观察匹配奖励或用于奖励构建的外部多模态教师。

title: DroneWAM: Efficient World Action Model for Drone Visual Navigation
summary: World-action models give visual navigation agents a way to anticipate how candidate actions will change future observations and to act from the predicted consequences. For drones, this capability must operate under tight accuracy and efficiency constraints. We present DroneWAM, an efficient world-action model for drone visual navigation. DroneWAM adopts a JEPA-based architecture to model future states directly in representation space, avoiding the cost of explicit future image generation. A pretrained Resampler further compresses dense encoder features into fewer latent tokens, reducing the computation repeated at each imagined step. We also introduce adaptive rollout, where a preference-trained Gate adaptively allocates prediction depth according to the current scene. To support learning under richer aerial motion, we construct DroneNav-6D, a simulated visual navigation dataset with synchronized RGB observations, 6-DoF flight trajectories, control commands, and randomized wind disturbances. On DroneNav-6D, DroneWAM achieves the best trajectory accuracy among the compared methods. Adaptive rollout further reduces the average prediction depth from 8 to 4.58 while improving trajectory accuracy, demonstrating that predictive computation can be allocated more effectively across scenes. \href{https://github.com/1e12Leon/DroneWAM}{Codes and data} will be released.
tldr: DroneWAM presents an efficient JEPA-based world action model for drone visual navigation, using a pretrained resampler and adaptive rollout to predict future states in latent space and reduce computation while improving trajectory accuracy on a new simulated dataset.
tldr_zh: DroneWAM提出了一种基于JEPA的高效无人机视觉导航世界动作模型，通过预训练重采样器和自适应展开在潜在空间中预测未来状态，在减少计算的同时提高了轨迹精度。
summary_zh: 世界-动作模型为视觉导航智能体提供了一种方式，使其能够预测候选动作将如何改变未来观测，并根据预测结果采取行动。对于无人机而言，这一能力必须在严格的精度与效率约束下运行。我们提出了DroneWAM，一种用于无人机视觉导航的高效世界-动作模型。DroneWAM采用基于JEPA的架构，直接在表示空间中建模未来状态，从而避免了显式生成未来图像的代价。预训练的Resampler进一步将密集的编码器特征压缩为更少的潜在令牌，减少了每次想象步骤中重复计算的开销。我们还引入了自适应展开机制，其中经过偏好训练的Gate根据当前场景自适应地分配预测深度。为了支持在更丰富的空中运动场景下的学习，我们构建了DroneNav-6D，一个包含同步RGB观测、六自由度飞行轨迹、控制指令以及随机风扰动的模拟视觉导航数据集。在DroneNav-6D上，DroneWAM在对比方法中取得了最优的轨迹精度。自适应展开进一步将平均预测深度从8降至4.58，同时提升了轨迹精度，表明预测计算能够跨场景更有效地分配。代码与数据将在\href{https://github.com/1e12Leon/DroneWAM}{此处}发布。

title: SV2V-RSim: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Self-Selective V2V Cooperative Perception with Near-Realistic Data
summary: Vehicle-to-Vehicle (V2V) cooperative perception enhances autonomous driving by enabling vehicles to share information beyond their direct line of sight. However, existing V2V datasets are limited by a small number of participating agents, static collaborator selection strategies, and a significant domain gap between simulated and real-world environments. To overcome these challenges, we introduce SV2V-RSim, a large-scale, multi-modal, near-realistic simulation dataset engineered to elevate agent diversity and realism. Additionally, we present the Select Vehicles Adaptively (SVA) module, which optimizes collaborator selection to balance perception performance against communication bandwidth constraints. Our dataset is generated using the Unreal Engine 5-based simulator that integrates high-fidelity 3D assets, diverse environments, and intricate traffic scenarios. All vehicles within a specified range of the ego vehicle are equipped with sensor suites, enabling dynamic and adaptive collaborator selection. SV2V-RSim encompasses four maps, four weather conditions, six time periods from sunrise to night, 203K LiDAR frames, 402K RGB frames, and 788K annotated 3D bounding boxes across 17 object classes, supporting a range of cooperative perception tasks such as 3D object detection, segmentation, and depth estimation. Benchmarking on recent cooperative perception algorithms demonstrates that SVA achieves a superior performance-bandwidth trade-off, while sim-to-real experiments and No-Reference Image Quality Assessment validate the dataset's high realism and practical effectiveness. Our dataset and code will be publicly available.
tldr: SV2V-RSim is a large-scale, near-realistic V2V cooperative perception benchmark with diverse agents, environments, and a novel SVA module for adaptive collaborator selection that improves the performance-bandwidth trade-off.
tldr_zh: SV2V-RSim 是一个大规模、近真实的V2V协同感知基准，具有多样的智能体和环境，并提出了SVA模块用于自适应协作车辆选择，以优化性能-带宽权衡。
summary_zh: 车辆间（V2V）协同感知通过使车辆能够共享其直接视线之外的信息来增强自动驾驶能力。然而，现有的V2V数据集受限于参与智能体数量少、协作车辆选择策略静态以及模拟环境与真实环境之间存在显著域差距等问题。为克服这些挑战，我们提出了SV2V-RSim，一个大规模、多模态、近真实的仿真数据集，旨在提升智能体多样性和真实感。此外，我们提出了自适应车辆选择（SVA）模块，该模块优化协作车辆的选择，以在感知性能与通信带宽约束之间取得平衡。我们的数据集使用基于虚幻引擎5的仿真器生成，该仿真器集成了高保真3D资产、多样化环境和复杂交通场景。自车指定范围内的所有车辆均配备传感器套件，从而实现动态且自适应的协作车辆选择。SV2V-RSim包含四张地图、四种天气条件、从日出到夜晚的六个时间段、203K帧激光雷达数据、402K帧RGB图像以及覆盖17个物体类别的788K个标注3D边界框，支持多种协同感知任务，如3D目标检测、分割和深度估计。在近期协同感知算法上的基准测试表明，SVA实现了优越的性能-带宽权衡，而仿真到真实的实验以及无参考图像质量评估验证了该数据集的高真实性和实际有效性。我们的数据集和代码将公开发布。

title: ALDER: Discovering the Laws of a World by Acting in It
summary: Reliable world models should not only predict future states but express how actions change the world in an explicit, transparent and testable form, such as equations. Yet methods that rely on a fixed set of trajectories cannot distinguish equally good competing hypotheses, while searches over a fixed set of predefined candidates cannot discover equations outside the initial hypothesis space. We introduce ALDER (Action-guided Law Discovery, Evaluation, and Revision), a method that actively proposes novel experiments to test and revise models. Specifically, ALDER proposes parametric equations; a numerical optimizer fits their coefficients; an independent verifier tests these candidates on held-out data. To distinguish between competing valid hypotheses, a cost- and safety-aware selector queries interventions, in the form of novel experiments. The resulting counterexamples update the evidence ledger and guide the next structural revision, while incompatible laws are discarded. Across an in-house benchmark, ODE equation discovery tasks, and robotic experiments, ALDER discovers laws beyond its initial formula set, repairs failed model proposals, distinguishes fixed candidate models with fewer interactions, and improves out-of-distribution prediction. Furthermore, given a current state and a target, ALDER selects control actions by solving the inverse problem defined by its validated world model. Together, these results show that explicit equation-based world models can be tested and revised through interaction, then naturally used to guide goal-directed control.
tldr: ALDER actively proposes and tests equation-based world models through novel experiments, enabling discovery, revision, and use of explicit laws for control, validated on robotic tasks.
tldr_zh: ALDER通过主动设计实验来提出和验证基于方程的世界模型，能够发现和修正定律，并用于目标导向控制，在机器人任务上得到验证。
summary_zh: 可靠的世界模型不仅应预测未来状态，还应以明确、透明且可检验的形式（如方程）表达行动如何改变世界。然而，依赖固定轨迹集的方法无法区分同样有效的竞争性假设，而对固定预定义候选集的搜索则无法发现初始假设空间之外的方程。我们引入了ALDER（行动引导的定律发现、评估与修订），这是一种主动提出新实验以检验和修订模型的方法。具体而言，ALDER提出参数化方程；数值优化器拟合其系数；独立的验证器在留出数据上测试这些候选模型。为了区分相互竞争的合理假设，一个考虑成本与安全的选择器以新实验的形式查询干预措施。由此产生的反例更新证据台账并指导下一步的结构修订，同时不兼容的定律被丢弃。在内部基准测试、常微分方程发现任务以及机器人实验中，ALDER发现了超出其初始公式集的定律，修复了失败的模型提案，以更少的交互区分了固定候选模型，并改善了分布外预测。此外，给定当前状态和目标，ALDER通过求解由其验证过的世界模型定义的逆问题来选择控制动作。这些结果共同表明，基于方程的显式世界模型可以通过交互进行测试和修订，并自然地用于指导目标导向的控制。

title: Adaptive Latent Capacity for World Models
summary: We introduce Adaptive LeWorldModel (ALeWM), a world model based on a joint-embedding predictive architecture (JEPA) that learns to concentrate predictive information in compact prefixes of a wide latent representation. To encourage this ordering, ALeWM learns a sequence-conditioned distribution over prefix lengths and trains the predictor to estimate the full next embedding from a sampled input prefix. As standard anti-collapse objectives encourage variation across latent coordinates and do not organize them by predictive importance, we also introduce MixSIGReg. MixSIGReg regularizes the masked embeddings against a prior-weighted mixture with Gaussian active prefixes and zeros in the remaining coordinates. As a result, the ALeWM objective encourages early coordinates to retain information useful for prediction and recursive planning. Our analysis shows that the mixture distribution used by MixSIGReg assigns higher variance to earlier coordinate blocks and lower variance to later ones. In addition, we show that, under specified assumptions, prediction error is minimized by placing the information most useful for prediction in earlier blocks. Empirically, we study the behavior of ALeWM in a controlled dynamical system with known state variables and in goal-conditioned visual control. We show that ALeWM consistently achieves higher mean success rates than tuned fixed-width LeWM, with lower planning capacity on average.
tldr: ALeWM introduces an adaptive-prefix JEPA world model that concentrates predictive information in compact latent prefixes and uses MixSIGReg regularization, achieving higher success rates in goal-conditioned visual control with reduced planning capacity.
tldr_zh: ALeWM提出了一种基于自适应前缀的JEPA世界模型，通过MixSIGReg正则化将预测信息集中在紧凑的潜在前缀中，在目标条件视觉控制中实现了更高的成功率并降低了规划容量。
summary_zh: 我们引入了自适应LeWorldModel（ALeWM），这是一种基于联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）的世界模型，其学习将预测信息集中在宽潜变量表示的紧凑前缀中。为了促进这种排序，ALeWM学习一个以序列为条件的前缀长度分布，并训练预测器从采样的输入前缀中估计完整的下一时刻嵌入。由于标准抗坍塌目标鼓励潜变量坐标之间的变异性，但并未按预测重要性对其进行组织，我们还引入了MixSIGReg。MixSIGReg通过对掩码嵌入施加正则化，使其与结合了高斯活动前缀和其余坐标置零的先验加权混合分布相匹配。因此，ALeWM的目标函数鼓励早期坐标保留对预测和递归规划有用的信息。我们的分析表明，MixSIGReg所使用的混合分布为较早的坐标块分配了更高的方差，而为较晚的坐标块分配了更低的方差。此外，我们证明，在特定假设下，将最有用的预测信息放置在较早的块中能够最小化预测误差。在实验上，我们在一个具有已知状态变量的受控动力系统以及目标条件视觉控制任务中研究了ALeWM的行为。结果表明，与经过调优的固定宽度LeWM相比，ALeWM在平均规划容量更低的情况下，始终实现了更高的平均成功率。

title: A Disk-Shaped Magnetoelastic Torque Sensor for Robotic Joints Using Permanent Magnetization
summary: Direct torque sensing is a growing need in the robotics community to enable precise control and interactions where torque estimation from motor current is not sufficient. This paper presents a novel disk-shaped magnetoelastic torque sensor with a compact axial envelope of about 1 cm, suitable for integration in robotic joints. A four-magnetometer architecture is used to measure the field modulated by the stress affecting a narrow magnetized region while rejecting the effects of parasitic cross forces. A custom-designed magnetic shield enhances the torque sensitivity while reducing the external stray fields by a factor 7x. The device measures the torque with an accuracy of 1.34 %FS relative to the 50 Nm full scale (FS). The paper details the development of the sensor through the mechanical design, the magnetization procedure, and the experimental validation. The results demonstrate the potential of the proposed sensor for robotic applications.
tldr: This paper presents a compact disk-shaped magnetoelastic torque sensor for robotic joints, using a four-magnetometer architecture with magnetic shielding to achieve high accuracy and reject parasitic forces, validated experimentally.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于机器人关节的紧凑盘形磁弹性扭矩传感器，采用四磁力计架构和磁屏蔽，实现高精度和抗干扰，并通过实验验证。
summary_zh: 直接力矩传感是机器人领域日益增长的需求，因为当仅通过电机电流进行力矩估算不足时，需要实现精确的控制与交互。本文提出了一种新型盘状磁弹性力矩传感器，其轴向结构紧凑，厚度约为1厘米，适合集成于机器人关节中。该传感器采用四磁力计架构，用于测量受应力影响的窄磁化区域所调制的磁场，同时抑制寄生横向力的干扰。定制设计的磁屏蔽罩将力矩灵敏度提升，并将外部杂散磁场降低至原来的七分之一。该器件在50牛米满量程（FS）范围内实现了1.34%FS的力矩测量精度。本文详细介绍了传感器的开发过程，包括机械设计、磁化流程及实验验证。结果表明，所提出的传感器在机器人应用中具有广阔的前景。

title: TC-ADA: One-Shot Active Domain Adaptation for Semantic Segmentation
summary: Manual dense annotation remains a major obstacle to deploying semantic segmentation models in new driving environments. Active domain adaptation (ADA) seeks label-efficient transfer by annotating only a selected portion of the target domain. Existing ADA methods commonly implement this process through multiple rounds of acquisition, annotation, and retraining. We study a practical one-shot image-level setting that selects and densely annotates a fixed target subset in a single round, followed by uninterrupted adaptation. Within this setting, we develop Target-Calibrated Active Domain Adaptation (TC-ADA) as a joint design of complete-image acquisition and target-calibrated adaptation. Stage~1 uses visual representations from a vision foundation model (VFM) together with semantic predictions from a fixed unsupervised domain adaptation model to select representative and informative target images without target annotations. Stage~2 jointly uses labeled source data, labeled target data, and the remaining unlabeled target data, while calibrating source and target supervision under limited target labels. Extensive experiments across five synthetic-to-real and real-to-real driving transfers show consistent improvements over representative ADA baselines. With only 23 to 46 labeled target images on four transfers and 140 on Mapillary, TC-ADA stays within 1.9 mean intersection over union (mIoU) points of target-only full supervision. Code will be available at https://github.com/ywher/TC-ADA.
tldr: TC-ADA proposes a one-shot active domain adaptation method for semantic segmentation in driving scenes, using a vision foundation model and a fixed UDA model to select informative target images and calibrating source/target supervision to improve segmentation under limited labels.
tldr_zh: TC-ADA 提出了一种用于驾驶场景语义分割的一次性主动域适应方法，利用视觉基础模型和固定UDA模型选择信息丰富的目标图像，并在有限标签下校准源/目标监督以提升分割性能。
summary_zh: 手动密集标注仍然是阻碍语义分割模型在新驾驶环境中部署的主要障碍。主动域自适应（ADA）旨在通过仅标注目标域的选定部分来实现标签高效迁移。现有的ADA方法通常通过多轮获取、标注和再训练来完成这一过程。我们研究了一种实用的一次性图像级设置，即在单轮中选定并密集标注固定的目标子集，随后进行不间断的自适应。在此设置下，我们提出了目标校准主动域自适应（TC-ADA），作为完整图像获取与目标校准自适应的联合设计。第一阶段利用视觉基础模型（VFM）的视觉表示以及固定无监督域自适应模型的语义预测，在无目标标注的情况下选择具有代表性和信息量的目标图像。第二阶段联合使用有标签源数据、有标签目标数据及剩余的无标签目标数据，并在有限目标标签下对源域和目标域的监督信号进行校准。在五个合成到真实及真实到真实的驾驶迁移任务上的大量实验表明，该方法相较于代表性的ADA基线方法具有一致的性能提升。在四个迁移任务中仅使用23至46张有标签目标图像，在Mapillary上使用140张，TC-ADA的平均交并比（mIoU）与仅使用目标域全监督方法相比差距保持在1.9个百分点以内。代码将在https://github.com/ywher/TC-ADA发布。

title: AevaScenes: An FMCW LiDAR Dataset and Benchmark for Long-Range Perception
summary: FMCW LiDAR measures per-point radial Doppler velocity alongside range, providing a motion cue unavailable in conventional time-of-flight sensors. Exploiting this signal at long range remains understudied. We present an FMCW LiDAR dataset of 575 sequences (57.5K frames) with over 8 million annotated 3D boxes across 16 detection classes and per-point labels across 24 semantic classes, captured by six commercial FMCW LiDAR sensors and six paired 4K cameras across eight Bay Area cities, including 237 nighttime sequences, with annotations extending to 400m. We define a benchmark with three tasks: 3D object detection, scene flow estimation, and semantic segmentation. Detection and scene flow are evaluated across three range bins to 400m, with a public evaluation server. We explore the impact of Doppler measurements on flagship recognition tasks, and find significant improvements up to 2X in detection AP of far-away vehicles and pedestrians, particularly in low-latency single-frame settings. We similarly find scene flow accuracy is significantly improved with Doppler measurements across all ranges. Our dataset and benchmark have been publicly released at https://scenes.aeva.com.
tldr: This paper introduces AevaScenes, a large-scale FMCW LiDAR dataset with Doppler velocity annotations, and benchmarks for 3D object detection, scene flow, and semantic segmentation, showing that Doppler cues significantly improve long-range perception.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了AevaScenes，一个大规模FMCW激光雷达数据集，包含多普勒速度标注，并提供了3D目标检测、场景流和语义分割基准，证明多普勒线索显著提升远距离感知。
summary_zh: FMCW激光雷达在测距的同时测量每个点的径向多普勒速度，提供了传统飞行时间传感器无法获得的运动线索。利用这一信号进行远距离探测的研究仍相对不足。我们发布了一个包含575个序列（57500帧）的FMCW激光雷达数据集，涵盖16个检测类别的超过800万个标注三维框，以及24个语义类别的逐点标注，数据由六个商用FMCW激光雷达传感器和六对4K相机在湾区八个城市采集，其中包括237个夜间序列，标注范围延伸至400米。我们定义了一个包含三项任务的基准：三维目标检测、场景流估计和语义分割。检测和场景流任务在三个距离区间内进行评估，直至400米，并提供公开评估服务器。我们探究了多普勒测量对核心识别任务的影响，发现对于远距离车辆和行人，检测平均精度（AP）最高可提升2倍，尤其是在低延迟单帧场景中。同样地，我们发现结合多普勒测量后，各距离区间的场景流精度均有显著提升。我们的数据集和基准已在https://scenes.aeva.com上公开发布。

title: When Does Backpropagating Through Policy Memory Matter? Physical Credit, Optimizer Updates, and Observability
summary: Policies with memory can learn along two backward paths: through the physical states their actions produce and through the representations they store. Transformer-XL and truncated backpropagation through time cut the second path at stored history while keeping its values. We ask when this cut matters. Holding the forward computation fixed and varying only derivative edges, we measure parameter gradients, the updates the optimizer applies, and continued training in a Transformer vessel-trajectory model and a quadrotor tracking policy. In the vessel model, detaching the key-value cache shrank the gradient to about a tenth of its norm, with little rotation, when gradients flowed through all earlier physical states, but barely changed it under one-step physical credit. In this strongly clipped regime the optimizer, not the gradient, set how far updates differed: global-norm clipping removed most of the gradient difference between memory-cut graphs, whereas AdamW turned a 2% gradient difference between two placements of the cut into update differences of up to 31% at the step where the placement was switched. In a quadrotor trained from initialization with 0.20 m/s velocity noise, removing memory raised tracking error by 43% and cutting memory gradients raised it by 32%; at low noise the cut's mean cost exceeded the value of memory. Two-step truncation segments gave no measurable gain, although with hidden velocity a two-step window captured most of the value of memory; eight-step segments removed half to three quarters of the cost. Switching the cut on only for the last fifth of training understated its cost about threefold at 0.20-0.30 m/s, but not at low noise or with hidden velocity. These results suggest measuring the cost of a memory cut by training with it from initialization, and comparing backward graphs by the updates the optimizer applies rather than by raw gradients.
